words.example: I don't see why age should limit you.

words.englishDefinition: Reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常熱することにより固体から液体の状態へ減少する、あるいは減少される原因となる。
words.example: I think that the snow will melt soon.

words.englishDefinition: Notice or perceive
words.japaneseExplanation: 気づく、または知覚する。
words.example: I think she wants you to notice her.

words.englishDefinition: to arrange things or plan an event
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を整理したり、行事を準備したりすること。
words.example: We need to organize the school festival together.

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture or cover a surface using paint
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵の具で絵を描くことや、塗料を塗ること。
words.example: We are going to paint the classroom walls blue.

words.englishDefinition: Make a promise or commitment
words.japaneseExplanation: 約束する、または、誓約する。
words.example: Please promise me that you'll never lie to me again.

words.englishDefinition: Prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般への配布または販売に備える、発行する。
words.example: I haven't had the time these days to publish it.

words.englishDefinition: Turn away from; give up
words.japaneseExplanation: 拒否する。やめる。
words.example: I made up my mind to quit smoking from now on.

words.englishDefinition: Detect with the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚で検出する。
words.example: I wonder if she will recognize me after all those years.

words.englishDefinition: Have confidence or faith in
words.japaneseExplanation: 信用、または信頼する。
words.example: I don't think we should rely on Tom too much.

words.englishDefinition: Free from harm or evil
words.japaneseExplanation: 危害または不正から開放する。
words.example: I hope someone comes to rescue us.

words.englishDefinition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
words.japaneseExplanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
words.example: Do you know how to sail a boat?

words.englishDefinition: Shape or influence; give direction to
words.japaneseExplanation: 形または影響。指示を与える。
words.example: You have the power to shape the universe.

words.englishDefinition: A theatrical representation of a story that is performed to music by trained dancers
words.japaneseExplanation: 訓練されたダンサーによって音楽に合わせて演じられた演劇上演。
words.example: We tried out for the ballet team.

words.englishDefinition: A seat of government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の所在地。
words.example: What is the capital of her country?

words.englishDefinition: A formal event performed on a special occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な機会にとり行われる公式行事。
words.example: I don't want to take part in the ceremony.

words.englishDefinition: A professional cook
words.japaneseExplanation: プロのコック。
words.example: How many years did you work as a chef?

words.englishDefinition: The weather in some location averaged over some long period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: ある長い期間にわたってある場所で平均化された天気。
words.example: You can easily get sick in a climate like this.

words.englishDefinition: The shore of a sea or ocean
words.japaneseExplanation: 海や大洋の岸。
words.example: We went to the coast for our summer vacation.

words.englishDefinition: A commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
words.japaneseExplanation: ラジオあるいはテレビでの商業的なスポンサーがついた広告。
words.example: I went to a commercial high school.

words.englishDefinition: An accounting entry acknowledging income or capital items
words.japaneseExplanation: 収入または主要な項目を認めている会計項目。
words.example: I don't have a credit card or a bank account.

words.englishDefinition: Something used to beautify
words.japaneseExplanation: 美しくするために用いられるもの。
words.example: I don't really give a damn about the decoration of our wedding.

words.englishDefinition: A college or university building containing living quarters for students
words.japaneseExplanation: 学生用の居住棟を含む、単科大学または大学の建物。
words.example: My university has a dormitory.

words.englishDefinition: A collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display
words.japaneseExplanation: 公共に披露するための物（商品や芸術作品など）のコレクション。
words.example: How did you come up with the idea for this exhibition?

words.englishDefinition: The act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
words.japaneseExplanation: 管理された試験または調査を行う行為。
words.example: You can't be too careful when doing this experiment.

words.englishDefinition: A plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
words.japaneseExplanation: 製造のための施設のある1つかそれ以上の建物で成る工場。
words.example: My father and my older brother work in this factory.

words.englishDefinition: Very difficult; severely testing stamina or resolution
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に難しい。非常に厳しい気力と決意。
words.example: What kind of things are tough in your job?

words.englishDefinition: Including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 例外なくすべての構成要素を含むさま。1つ全体または全ての量、程度または持続時間をなす。
words.example: I spent the whole weekend at home on the computer.

words.englishDefinition: not present where someone is expected to be
words.japaneseExplanation: いるはずの場所にいないこと。学校では欠席を表す。
words.example: Two students were absent from class yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Having the same or similar characteristics
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じものまたは類似した特徴を持つ。
words.example: We do look alike, but it's still not me.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or caused by allergy
words.japaneseExplanation: アレルギーによって特徴付けられるか引き起こされる。
words.example: You aren't allergic to anything, are you?

words.englishDefinition: Obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 入手または利用可能で、使用またはサービスの準備が整っている。
words.example: How much power do we have available?

words.englishDefinition: Exceptionally bad or displeasing
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に悪いか、または不快である。
words.example: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.

words.englishDefinition: Pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
words.japaneseExplanation: 基礎または基盤に関連する、あるいは基礎または基盤となる。
words.example: I make use of Basic English.

words.englishDefinition: Pleasing or delighting
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜ばせるようなまたは好ましい。
words.example: What a charming little girl!

words.englishDefinition: Being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits
words.japaneseExplanation: 声援でいっぱいのまたは声援をすすめる。良い気分を持つまたは示す。
words.example: I had a cheerful morning because I could hear the songs of birds.

words.englishDefinition: A United States term for Blacks that is now considered offensive
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在では差別語とされる、米国で黒人を指す語。
words.example: I prefer black- and red-colored clothes.

words.englishDefinition: Unvarying in nature
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的に不変の。
words.example: I got sick of the constant noise of the street traffic.

words.englishDefinition: no longer alive
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きていない状態を表す形容詞。
words.example: We removed the dead leaves from the garden.

words.englishDefinition: The relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)
words.japaneseExplanation: 音節または音符の（特に強勢または音の高低に関する）相対的卓立。
words.example: I keep a stress ball on my desk.

words.englishDefinition: Be the physical support of; carry the weight of
words.japaneseExplanation: の人的支援である。の重さを支える。
words.example: I don't need you to support me.

words.englishDefinition: Ride the waves of the sea with a surfboard
words.japaneseExplanation: サーフボードで海の波に乗る。
words.example: I don't know how to surf very well.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be surprised
words.japaneseExplanation: 驚くべき原因。
words.example: You really surprised me with that gift, thank you.

words.englishDefinition: Extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle
words.japaneseExplanation: 同時に四方に広げる。取り囲む。
words.example: The children were sitting so as to surround the fire.

words.englishDefinition: Notify of danger, potential harm, or risk
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険、潜在的害または危険を通知する。
words.example: I came here to warn you about what might happen.

words.japanese: 重さを量る、〜の重さがある
words.englishDefinition: Have a certain weight
words.japaneseExplanation: 一定の重さを持つ。
words.example: I have decided to weigh myself every day starting today.

words.englishDefinition: Speak softly; in a low voice
words.japaneseExplanation: そっと言う。小さな声で。
words.example: I will love you until I let my last whisper out.

words.japanese: 利用する、アクセスする
words.englishDefinition: Reach or gain access to
words.japaneseExplanation: アクセスに達する、またはアクセスする。
words.example: I think art should be free for everyone to access.

words.englishDefinition: To gain with effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で得る。
words.example: I don't understand what you want to achieve with that.

words.englishDefinition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
words.example: We didn't intend to attack him.

words.englishDefinition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
words.example: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Bring into balance or equilibrium
words.japaneseExplanation: バランスまたは平衡をもたらす。
words.example: How do you balance work and travel while on the road?

words.englishDefinition: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由である状態。外部から抑制を課されない状態で行動する、話す、あるいは考える力。
words.example: I enjoy having the freedom to think for myself.

words.englishDefinition: The vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さの垂直の寸法。何かの底から一番上までの距離。
words.example: Could you please tell me your height and weight?

words.englishDefinition: A man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
words.japaneseExplanation: 一際優れた勇気、高潔さ、強さで秀でた男性。
words.example: I don't want to be a hero.

words.englishDefinition: A visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面に作成された視覚表現（物、場面、人または抽象概念の）。
words.example: Could you explain to me what this image means?

words.englishDefinition: Small air-breathing arthropod
words.japaneseExplanation: 小型の空気呼吸を行う節足動物。
words.example: What do you call this insect in English?

words.englishDefinition: Undertake a journey or trip
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅または旅行を経験する。
words.example: You will certainly be tired, after such a long journey.

words.englishDefinition: The psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning
words.japaneseExplanation: 知覚、学習、論理的思考の心理的な結果。
words.example: My knowledge about Japanese is not that good yet.

words.englishDefinition: A position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 強さまたは量または品質の階級の位置。
words.example: I don't know why people say this level is hard.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
words.example: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

words.englishDefinition: Something that is remembered
words.japaneseExplanation: 覚えていること。
words.example: My memory failed me. I just couldn't remember his name.

words.englishDefinition: Sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound)
words.japaneseExplanation: あらゆる種類の音（特に曖昧な音や不協和音）。
words.example: I heard a noise coming from the next room.

words.englishDefinition: Generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives
words.japaneseExplanation: 一定の形の物や皮膜や単繊維に成形したり、例えば被覆剤や接着剤を作るのに使われる合成または半合成物質の総称。
words.example: Do you want a plastic or paper bag?

words.englishDefinition: The force of policemen and officers
words.japaneseExplanation: 警察官と警官の力。
words.example: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

words.englishDefinition: Exquisitely fine and subtle and pleasing; susceptible to injury
words.japaneseExplanation: この上なくすばらしくて、ほのかで、気持ちよい。けがをしやすい。
words.example: Please don't eat or drink near the computer, it's delicate.

words.englishDefinition: Greatly pleased
words.japaneseExplanation: 大喜びで。
words.example: I am delighted that it's all come to an end.

words.englishDefinition: needing someone or something for support
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物の支えを必要とすること。dependent on で「〜に頼っている」。
words.example: Young children are dependent on adults for many things.

words.englishDefinition: Suitable to or characteristic of drama
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇に適した、または劇に特有の。
words.example: I think you're being a bit over-dramatic.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons
words.japaneseExplanation: 電子工学に関する、またはそれの。電子の活動を支配する理論に基づいて動く装置に関してまたはそれを使用する。
words.example: I listen to a lot of electronic music.

words.englishDefinition: having a large amount of body fat
words.japaneseExplanation: 体の脂肪が多いこと。人への直接の呼びかけでは失礼になりやすい。
words.example: The vet said our cat was getting too fat.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of or peculiar to a woman
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性に特徴的な、または、女性に特有である。
words.example: I have a female dog and a female cat.

words.englishDefinition: Having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another
words.japaneseExplanation: 斜面のない表面を持つこと、一部分がもう一つより高くないまたは低くない傾斜。
words.example: I wouldn't want to live in a top-floor flat.

words.englishDefinition: Recently made, produced, or harvested
words.japaneseExplanation: 最近作られた、生産された、または収穫された。
words.example: I bought some fresh bread on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: Causing fear or dread or terror
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れまたは不安または恐怖を引き起こすさま。
words.example: I find the idea of dying frightening.

words.englishDefinition: for the usual number of working or studying hours
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の勤務時間や授業時間のすべてにわたること。
words.example: She is looking for a full-time job near home.

words.englishDefinition: Pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion
words.japaneseExplanation: 形体と比率の理想への調和による見かけ上の心地よさ。
words.example: I have never seen a man as handsome as him!

words.englishDefinition: Providing assistance or serving a useful function
words.japaneseExplanation: 援助を提供する、または、役に立つ機能を供給する。
words.example: You can be pretty helpful when you want to be.

words.englishDefinition: Hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か達成を妨げるか、または防ぐ。
words.example: I don't know how they were supposed to block that.

words.englishDefinition: Exhale hard
words.japaneseExplanation: 強く息を吐き出す。
words.example: I am waiting for the storm to blow over.

words.englishDefinition: Examine and note the similarities or differences of
words.japaneseExplanation: 類似点または相違点を検討し留意する。
words.example: I don't think you should compare yourself to others.

words.japanese: デートする、日付を付ける
words.englishDefinition: Go on a date with
words.japaneseExplanation: デートする。
words.example: I was dating a girl in high school who spoke Berber.

words.englishDefinition: Make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 飾り、色などを追加することによってより魅力的にする。
words.example: Can you help us to decorate the party room?

words.englishDefinition: Make smaller
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さくする。
words.example: What should you do to decrease your debt?

words.englishDefinition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
words.japaneseExplanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
words.example: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

words.englishDefinition: Create by digging
words.japaneseExplanation: 地面を取り除くことによって作り出す。
words.example: We had to dig a pretty deep well to get water.

words.englishDefinition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
words.japaneseExplanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
words.example: We had to discover that the hard way.

words.englishDefinition: To consider or examine in speech or writing
words.japaneseExplanation: スピーチまたは文章で熟慮するまたは調査する。
words.example: We used to discuss everything and now we can't talk about anything.

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
words.example: Can you draw a map of your neighborhood?

words.englishDefinition: Earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業またはビジネス取引で稼ぐ。給与または賃金で稼ぐ。
words.example: How much money do you expect to earn next year?

words.englishDefinition: Show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
words.japaneseExplanation: 属性、特性、知識、または技能を示す。
words.example: What is your favorite exhibit at the museum?

words.englishDefinition: The educator who has executive authority for a school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校を管理する権限を持つ教育者。
words.example: I got sent to the principal’s office today.

words.englishDefinition: The ability to see; the visual faculty
words.japaneseExplanation: 見る能力。視覚の機能。
words.example: My sight isn't as good as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: An event that accomplishes its intended purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図されていた目的を達成するでき事。
words.example: I have no doubt that the event will be a success.

words.englishDefinition: The degree of hotness or coldness of a body or environment (corresponding to its molecular activity)
words.japaneseExplanation: （分子活動に対応した）物体や環境の熱さや冷たさの度合い。
words.example: My mother called the doctor because I had a temperature.

words.englishDefinition: A sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner
words.japaneseExplanation: 競技者が勝者を決定するため一連の試合を行うスポーツ競争。
words.example: Our goal is to win the tournament this year.

words.englishDefinition: Noticeable heterogeneity
words.japaneseExplanation: 目立つ異種性。
words.example: You can catch a variety of fish while fishing.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
words.japaneseExplanation: やり遂げることができるという特質。達成または完成を可能にする、または助ける性質。
words.example: My boss has the ability to read books very fast.

words.englishDefinition: The statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
words.japaneseExplanation: 約束の交換の声明（口頭または書面の）。
words.example: I thought that we had an agreement.

words.englishDefinition: A person trained to compete in sports
words.japaneseExplanation: スポーツ競技を行う訓練を受けた人。
words.example: You have the body of an athlete.

words.englishDefinition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
words.example: What was the author thinking while he was writing this book?

words.englishDefinition: The grounds in back of a house
words.japaneseExplanation: 家の裏手にある庭。
words.example: You should find a house with a backyard.

words.englishDefinition: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
words.japaneseExplanation: 核分裂により生産される葉緑素のない単細胞、非細胞球形、渦巻き状の、あるいは棒状の有機体。病原菌として、および生化学の特性のために重要である。
words.example: You must make the bacteria inside you happy.

words.englishDefinition: The qualities that give pleasure to the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚に喜びを与える特性。
words.example: What does the beauty of a woman mean to you?

words.japanese: 歴史に関する、歴史上の
words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the study of history
words.japaneseExplanation: 歴史の研究の、または、歴史の研究に関する。
words.example: I wish Adriano could visit this historical place.

words.englishDefinition: Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement
words.japaneseExplanation: ある声明が前言を説明または支持することを示すのに使用される。
words.example: I don't like it, but I will do it anyway.

words.englishDefinition: For the environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 環境のために。
words.example: How environmentally friendly are electric cars?

words.englishDefinition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
words.example: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

words.englishDefinition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
words.example: I could do that fairly well when I was younger.

words.englishDefinition: By chance
words.japaneseExplanation: 偶然に。
words.example: I thought perhaps no one else would agree with me.

words.englishDefinition: To a great degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大いに。
words.example: What is the most widely read newspaper in your country?

words.englishDefinition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
words.example: I think we're going to eventually have to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
words.example: You are doing exactly what they want you to do.

words.englishDefinition: To or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage ('further' is used more often than 'farther' in this abstract sense)
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きな程度までに、またはより進んだ段階までに。
words.example: How about we discuss this situation further tomorrow morning, if you like?

words.englishDefinition: Usually; as a rule
words.japaneseExplanation: いつもは。通例。
words.example: I don't like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.

words.englishDefinition: To an extraordinary extent or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 並外れた範囲、または程度。
words.example: I love you greatly, not just a bit.

words.englishDefinition: According to nature; by natural means; without artificial help
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然に従って。自然な方法で。
words.example: I don't know how, but I just picked it up naturally.

words.japanese: 満たす、いっぱいにする
words.englishDefinition: Make full, also in a metaphorical sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 比喩的な感覚においても、いっぱいにする。
words.example: I am going to fill you up so full.

words.englishDefinition: Move or progress freely as if in a stream
words.japaneseExplanation: 流れにいるかのように自由に動き前進する。
words.example: Our conversation seemed to flow easily.

words.englishDefinition: Stop blaming or grant forgiveness
words.japaneseExplanation: 非難することをやめるまたは許しを与える。
words.example: I doubt I'll ever be able to forgive him.

words.englishDefinition: Change to ice
words.japaneseExplanation: 氷への変化。
words.example: Please freeze the fish and meat.

words.englishDefinition: Engage or hire for work
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
words.example: How many more people do we need to hire?

words.englishDefinition: Pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals)
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物またはスポーツのために追求する（野生動物のような）。
words.example: I can teach you how to hunt.

words.japanese: 感動させる、印象づける
words.englishDefinition: Have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情的であるか認識影響を及ぼす。
words.example: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.

words.englishDefinition: Cause injuries or bodily harm to
words.japaneseExplanation: 怪我または身体傷害を引き起こす。
words.example: You have to be careful so as not to injure yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
words.japaneseExplanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
words.example: I think that it's too soon to judge.

words.englishDefinition: Raise from a lower to a higher position
words.japaneseExplanation: 低い位置から高い位置に上げる。
words.example: I wasn't strong enough to lift the box by myself.

words.japanese: 位置を特定する、見つける
words.englishDefinition: Discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining
words.japaneseExplanation: 位置を見つける。位置を決定する。
words.example: Can you locate this place on the map for me?

words.englishDefinition: Determine the measurements of something or somebody, take measurements of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かまたは誰かの測定値を測定する、を測定する。
words.example: I will measure the weight of the horse.

words.englishDefinition: Commit to memory; learn by heart
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶する。暗記する、空で覚える。
words.example: You should memorize as many English words as possible.

words.englishDefinition: Manner of acting or controlling yourself
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分らしく振る舞う、または自分を管理する方法。
words.example: I can't put up with his behavior any longer.

words.englishDefinition: Reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 被子植物の生殖器官で特に目立ったり、あるいはカラフルな部分を持つもの。
words.example: My tree had some blossom, but no fruit.

words.englishDefinition: By bad luck
words.japaneseExplanation: あいにく。
words.example: I would like to be there, but unfortunately I cannot.

words.japanese: そうでなければ、別の点では
words.englishDefinition: if not; in a different way
words.japaneseExplanation: 「そうでなければ」や「それ以外の点では」を表す。
words.example: Let's leave now. Otherwise, we will miss the train.

words.englishDefinition: An activity or gift that benefits the public at large
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会全般のためになる活動もしくは贈り物。
words.example: I got these shoes from a charity shop for £2.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝達する活動。情報を伝達する活動。
words.example: I think we get some communication problems here.

words.englishDefinition: A prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)
words.japaneseExplanation: 相談や情報交換、討論のための事前に取り決められた会議（特に公式の議事日程を持つもの）。
words.example: I want everyone in the conference room tomorrow morning by 8:00.

words.englishDefinition: Not often
words.japaneseExplanation: めったにない。
words.example: We often have to start again, but seldom from the beginning.

words.englishDefinition: An effort that is inconvenient
words.japaneseExplanation: 面倒な努力。
words.example: I had a lot of difficulty getting in touch with her.

words.englishDefinition: A line leading to a place or point
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所や点へ向かう線。
words.example: I looked in the direction of the window, but didn't see anything.

words.englishDefinition: The act of reducing the selling price of merchandise
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品の販売価格を下げる行為。
words.example: I don't think they actually get much of a discount.

words.englishDefinition: Separated or at a distance in place or position or time
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所、位置、または時間的に切り離された、または隔てられた。
words.example: My brother and I are less than two years apart.

words.englishDefinition: From appearances alone
words.japaneseExplanation: 外観だけから。
words.example: I thought Tom had paid Mary, but apparently I was wrong.

words.englishDefinition: at the present time, compared with the past
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去と比べて「最近は」「今日では」を表す。
words.example: Many people use their phones to read the news nowadays.

words.englishDefinition: In an original manner
words.japaneseExplanation: もともとのやり方で。
words.example: How did the idea for this originally come up?

words.englishDefinition: Money in the form of bills or coins
words.japaneseExplanation: 紙幣や硬貨の形態をした貨幣。
words.example: I need to get money out from the cash machine.

words.englishDefinition: With rapid movements
words.japaneseExplanation: 急速な動きで。
words.example: I learn new ideas rapidly.

words.englishDefinition: A cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
words.japaneseExplanation: 大規模に営利目的で成育される栽培植物。
words.example: We are the cream of the crop!

words.englishDefinition: In or at or to some place
words.japaneseExplanation: どこかに、で、またはに向かって。
words.example: I must have dropped it somewhere around here.

words.englishDefinition: A woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects
words.japaneseExplanation: 木工品を作ったり修理したりする大工。
words.example: I have a Canadian friend who is a carpenter.

words.englishDefinition: To or in a foreign country
words.japaneseExplanation: 外国の、または外国で。
words.example: I had never been abroad before, so everything seemed strange to me.

words.englishDefinition: An impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning
words.japaneseExplanation: 健康障害もしくは、機能異常の状態。
words.example: I can't remember the name of the disease my father has.

words.englishDefinition: The activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill
words.japaneseExplanation: 教育または指導の活動。知識を授ける活動。
words.example: I am surprised at the education of these children.

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: さらに。
words.example: I don't want to go, and besides it's too late.

words.englishDefinition: On a floor below
words.japaneseExplanation: 下の階に。
words.example: I know the man who lives downstairs.

words.englishDefinition: To the same degree (often followed by 'as')
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ程度に。
words.example: We tried to share the little there was as equally as possible.

words.englishDefinition: to leave a vehicle in a particular place
words.japaneseExplanation: 車を決めた場所に止めておくこと。
words.example: You can park your car behind the building.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to run
words.japaneseExplanation: 走らせる。
words.example: Please pour me a glass of water.

words.englishDefinition: Exert pressure or force to or upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 圧迫を加える、強制する、あるいは力を加える。
words.example: I don't want to press you.

words.englishDefinition: Keep from happening or arising; make impossible
words.japaneseExplanation: 起きてしまうことまたは発生することを防ぐ。不可能にする。
words.example: We have to prevent such an accident from happening again.

words.englishDefinition: Give something useful or necessary to
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを役に立つまたは必要であるものにする。
words.example: I will provide you all the necessary information.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move by pulling
words.japaneseExplanation: 引くことにより動きを引き起こす。
words.example: I think she was trying to pull a fast one.

words.englishDefinition: Move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"
words.japaneseExplanation: 力による動き、。
words.example: Please push the table over this way.

words.japanese: 再利用する、再資源化する
words.englishDefinition: Use again after processing
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理の後で再度使用する。
words.example: I wish more people would recycle.

words.englishDefinition: Cut down on; make a reduction in
words.japaneseExplanation: カットして減らす。減少させる。
words.example: I think that we should reduce the price.

words.englishDefinition: Remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か具体的なものを削除する、持ち上げる、押すこと、あるいは切り離すことなどにより、あるいは何か抽象的なものを削除する。
words.example: I had to remove some of the things I had.

words.englishDefinition: To say, state, or perform again
words.japaneseExplanation: かさねて言う、述べる、または行う。
words.example: Could you please repeat it once again?

words.englishDefinition: Substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
words.japaneseExplanation: の代わりに人またはものを代用する（壊れている、能率が悪い、紛失した、これ以上動かないあるいは期待されていることを産出できない別のもの）。
words.example: We won't be able to replace it.

words.englishDefinition: Have need of
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性を有する。
words.example: We know doing that will require a lot of money.

words.englishDefinition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
words.japaneseExplanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
words.example: We were all surprised at the effect the news had on him.

words.englishDefinition: An opposing military force
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵対する軍隊。
words.example: We have to drive the enemy out of our land.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs
words.japaneseExplanation: 動作する物理的システムの容量と同等の熱力学量。エネルギーの単位はジュールとエルグである。
words.example: I don't think I have the energy to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱のエネルギーを機械的な仕事に変換するモータ。
words.example: I got back in my car and started the engine.

words.englishDefinition: A person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学的知識を実用的な問題の解決に用いる人。
words.example: My father works for the company as an engineer.

words.englishDefinition: Something that provides access (to get in or get out)
words.japaneseExplanation: 出入りを提供するもの（入る、または、出る）。
words.example: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.

words.englishDefinition: An instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
words.japaneseExplanation: 課題あるいはサービスを実行するのに必要な物。
words.example: We had a little trouble with the equipment yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
words.japaneseExplanation: 健康を維持するための様々な方法での筋肉の鍛錬。
words.example: I think you should stop watching TV and get some exercise.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who travels into little known regions (especially for some scientific purpose)
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんど知られていない地域を旅する人（特に科学的目的で）。
words.example: After playing outside, the first thing you should do is wash your hands, my little explorer.

words.englishDefinition: The latest and most admired style in clothes and cosmetics and behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 服装、美容、行動における、最も新しく最も賞賛を浴びている様式。
words.example: I never want to hear you talking in this fashion again.

words.englishDefinition: One of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration
words.japaneseExplanation: 記数の体系を集合的に形作る要素の1つ。
words.example: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

words.englishDefinition: A prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop
words.japaneseExplanation: （天気のような）何かがどのようになるかについての予報。
words.example: Do you know what the weather forecast is for tomorrow?

words.englishDefinition: Furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋または他のエリアを居住できるようにする道具。
words.example: I want to move the furniture in the room.

words.englishDefinition: For a very long or seemingly endless time
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に長いか、一見終りのない時間のために。
words.example: We are not on the earth forever, but only for a time.

words.englishDefinition: By good fortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸運にも、運よく。
words.example: Fortunately, the weather was good and we were able to eat outside.

words.englishDefinition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
words.japaneseExplanation: それは、誠実に本当である。
words.example: I quite frankly don't know.

words.englishDefinition: every time that; at any time that
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜するときはいつでも」「〜するたびに」を表す。
words.example: You can ask me whenever you need help.

words.englishDefinition: except if
words.japaneseExplanation: 「もし〜でなければ」を表す。if ... not に近い意味。
words.example: We will play outside unless it rains.

words.englishDefinition: used to introduce two possibilities or uncertainty
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜かどうか」を表し、二つの可能性を示す。
words.example: I don't know whether the shop is open today.

words.englishDefinition: in or to any place that
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜する所ならどこでも」を表す。
words.example: You can sit wherever you feel comfortable.

words.englishDefinition: not including
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体から特定の人や物を除くこと。
words.example: The shop is open every day except Monday.

words.englishDefinition: until a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜まで」を表し、until と同じように使う。
words.example: I'll wait here till you come back.

words.englishDefinition: farther than a place, limit, or ability
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所・限界・能力などを越えていること。
words.example: There is a small village beyond those hills.

words.englishDefinition: without being prevented by something
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
words.example: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

words.englishDefinition: in the direction of
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や場所などに向かう方向を表す。towards とも書く。
words.example: We walked toward the station after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: A canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise
words.japaneseExplanation: 祈祷辞官は日の出からその日のうちで9時間目である。
words.example: I hope that none of them got into an accident.

words.englishDefinition: Go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position
words.japaneseExplanation: 隠居する、退職する。その人の仕事を実行するのを止めるあるいは、その人の職務から撤退する。
words.example: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.

words.englishDefinition: Sound loudly and sonorously
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きく朗々と鳴り響く。
words.example: I don't want you to ring me up all the time.

words.englishDefinition: Utter a sudden loud cry
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然、大きい泣き声を発する。
words.example: I wanted to scream, but I couldn't find my voice at all.

words.englishDefinition: Utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
words.japaneseExplanation: 大声で話す。大きな声で話す（通常、特徴的な話し方を示して）。
words.example: You don't have to shout. I can hear you.

words.englishDefinition: Look at with fixed eyes
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された視線で見る。
words.example: We stopped to stare at them.

words.englishDefinition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
words.example: I was just going to suggest that you do that.

words.englishDefinition: Continue to live through hardship or adversity
words.japaneseExplanation: 苦難または逆境を通して生き続ける。
words.example: We can survive without food... just not for too long.

words.englishDefinition: Make physical contact with, come in contact with
words.japaneseExplanation: と身体的に接触する、と接触する。
words.example: I know that you still want to touch my hand.

words.japanese: わなにかける、閉じ込める
words.englishDefinition: Place in a confining or embarrassing position
words.japaneseExplanation: 閉じ込めるまたは恥をかかせる状態に置く。
words.example: I didn't want to trap that animal.

words.englishDefinition: Interact in a certain way
words.japaneseExplanation: ある方法で交わる。
words.example: What did I do for you to treat me like this?

words.englishDefinition: Have confidence or faith in
words.japaneseExplanation: 信用、または信頼する。
words.example: I guess we just have to trust each other.

words.englishDefinition: to offer to help or work without being forced or paid
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分から申し出て活動すること。無償の奉仕活動にも使う。
words.example: I volunteer at the local animal shelter on weekends.

words.englishDefinition: Play a role or part
words.japaneseExplanation: 役割を果たす、役を演じる。
words.example: I feel it's still not too late to act.

words.englishDefinition: A room or series of rooms where works of art are exhibited
words.japaneseExplanation: 芸術作品が展示される部屋、または一連の部屋。
words.example: You should drop by his gallery if you have time.

words.englishDefinition: An established custom
words.japaneseExplanation: 確立した慣習。
words.example: I am in the habit of taking a walk every day.

words.englishDefinition: The consequence of an effort or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力あるいは活動の結果。
words.example: We all helped with the harvest.

words.englishDefinition: Intense and profound fear
words.japaneseExplanation: 強く根深い恐れ。
words.example: I couldn't bring myself to see the horror movie again.

words.englishDefinition: The work of cleaning and running a house
words.japaneseExplanation: 家をきれいにし経営する仕事。
words.example: I wish I didn't have to help with the housework.

words.englishDefinition: A message describing how something is to be done
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをするやり方を示すメッセージ。
words.example: I wish I had followed his instructions at that time.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 音楽を演奏するための道具の総称。
words.example: I don't know how to play an instrument.

words.englishDefinition: An important question that is in dispute and must be settled
words.japaneseExplanation: 論争の重要な論点で、解決しなければならないこと。
words.example: Could you share your honest opinion on this issue?

words.englishDefinition: A distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list
words.japaneseExplanation: リスト上で列挙される物も集団で別々に特定できる独立した部分。
words.example: How long have you and your girlfriend been an item?

words.englishDefinition: Kitchen appliance that cooks food by passing an electromagnetic wave through it; heat results from the absorption of energy by the water molecules in the food
words.japaneseExplanation: 電磁波を食物へ通すことでそれを調理する調理器具。食物の水分子のエネルギーの吸収による熱の結果。
words.example: How long should I put this in the microwave for?

words.englishDefinition: A change of position that does not entail a change of location
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所の変化を伴わない体勢の変化。
words.example: Does he have something in common with this movement?

words.englishDefinition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
words.example: We need a strong person to lead our nation.

words.englishDefinition: A brief written record
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡潔に書かれた記録。
words.example: I made a note of it.

words.englishDefinition: unwell or suffering from an illness
words.japaneseExplanation: 体調が悪いことや、病気であること。
words.example: I stayed home because I was feeling ill.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring with no delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 遅延なしで現れるさま。
words.example: I don't know. It all happened in an instant.

words.englishDefinition: Exercising or showing good judgment
words.japaneseExplanation: 良い判断を行うか、示すさま。
words.example: I am no more intelligent than he.

words.englishDefinition: unwilling to work or make an effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事や努力をしたがらないこと。
words.example: I felt lazy on Sunday and stayed in bed.

words.englishDefinition: Established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律、公式なまたは認められた規則によって設立されたあるいはによって創立された。
words.example: I believe I have no legal right to do so.

words.englishDefinition: Continuing through life
words.japaneseExplanation: 生涯続ける。
words.example: I have a lifelong problem of not giving myself enough credit.

words.englishDefinition: Roused to anger
words.japaneseExplanation: 怒りにかき立てられる。
words.example: I don't like it when you get mad.

words.englishDefinition: Around the middle of a scale of evaluation
words.japaneseExplanation: 評価の規模の真ん中の周辺で。
words.example: I would class my garden as medium in size.

words.englishDefinition: Mild and pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: 穏やかで、楽しい。
words.example: We had a mild winter last year.

words.japanese: 行方不明の、欠けている
words.englishDefinition: Not able to be found
words.japaneseExplanation: 見つかることができない。
words.example: I found several things missing from my room.

words.englishDefinition: Moving or capable of moving readily (especially from place to place)
words.japaneseExplanation: すばやく動くこくこと、あるいは、すばやく動くことができること（特に場所から場所に）。
words.example: Please don't look at your mobile phone while we're eating.

words.englishDefinition: Not wide
words.japaneseExplanation: 広くない。
words.example: We have to find a way to narrow down the list.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance; having no positive features
words.japaneseExplanation: 否定、否認、反対または抵抗により特徴付けられるか、または示すさま。肯定的な特性を持たないこと。
words.example: What is one negative thing your last boss say about you?

words.englishDefinition: Declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であることを宣言するあるいは存在、現実あるいは真実を認める。
words.example: I have to admit that he is right.

words.englishDefinition: Make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
words.japaneseExplanation: 宣伝する。売ろうとする（製品を）。
words.example: I think I will advertise in the paper.

words.englishDefinition: Be able to spare or give up
words.japaneseExplanation: 容赦するか、やめることができない。
words.example: I wish I'd been able to afford a better car.

words.englishDefinition: Announce publicly or officially
words.japaneseExplanation: 公に、または公式に発表する。
words.example: We plan to announce details about our plan tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠点、短所または失敗を認める。
words.example: I think he should apologize to the teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Avail oneself to
words.japaneseExplanation: を利用する。
words.example: You need your parents' permission if you are going to apply for that.

words.englishDefinition: Move towards
words.japaneseExplanation: そこに向かって動く。
words.example: I told him never to approach my son again.

words.englishDefinition: Present reasons and arguments
words.japaneseExplanation: 理由と論拠を提示する。
words.example: I don't want to argue in front of the children.

words.englishDefinition: Direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
words.japaneseExplanation: 心理学的力または物理的属性という手段でそのものまたはその人自身に直接向けられた。
words.example: How to attract and keep new customers for a small business?

words.englishDefinition: Give, especially as an honor or reward
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に名誉または報酬として、与える。
words.example: I would like to thank many people for helping me win this award, but I won't.

words.englishDefinition: To make the short, loud sound that a dog makes.
words.japaneseExplanation: 犬などが短く大きな声で吠えること。
words.example: We knew that the dogs would bark at us.

words.englishDefinition: Behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の方法で振る舞う。特定の振舞いを示す。
words.example: I don't need you telling me how to behave.

words.englishDefinition: Draw air into, and expel out of, the lungs
words.japaneseExplanation: 肺に空気を吸い込みはき出す。
words.example: I like to breathe the clean mountain air.

words.englishDefinition: A member of a police force
words.japaneseExplanation: 警察のメンバー。
words.example: Do you still want to be an officer?

words.englishDefinition: A collection of things wrapped or boxed together
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に包装されたり箱に入れられたりしている物の集まり。
words.example: Do you know who left this package on my desk?

words.englishDefinition: Someone who takes photographs professionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 写真撮影を職業とする人。
words.example: I like to take pictures so I will be a photographer.

words.englishDefinition: (astronomy) any of the nine large celestial bodies in the solar system that revolve around the sun and shine by reflected light; Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto in order of their proximity to the sun; viewed from the constellation Hercules, all the planets rotate around the sun in a counterclockwise direction
words.japaneseExplanation: 太陽の周りを公転し、反射光によって輝く太陽系の9つの大きな天体のいずれか。太陽から近い順に、水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星及び冥王星。
words.example: We were all born on this planet for a reason.

words.englishDefinition: The number of inhabitants (either the total number or the number of a particular race or class) in a given place (country or city etc.)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある土地（国または町など）の住人（総計または特定の民族、階級の数）の数。
words.example: How large is the population of this city?

words.englishDefinition: The particular portion of space occupied by something
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物質によって占められている空間的な部分。
words.example: Do you think he is good for the position?

words.englishDefinition: An artifact that has been created by someone or some process
words.japaneseExplanation: 人やある過程を経て生み出される人工品。
words.example: We need some more information about that product.

words.englishDefinition: A young dog
words.japaneseExplanation: 小犬。
words.example: I have had this dog since she was a puppy.

words.englishDefinition: An acknowledgment (usually tangible) that payment has been made
words.japaneseExplanation: 支払いがされたという（普通有形の）承認書。
words.example: Please wait a moment while I write out your receipt.

words.englishDefinition: Directions for making something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを作るための指示。
words.example: Can you teach me how to cook that recipe?

words.englishDefinition: A frequently visited place
words.japaneseExplanation: 頻繁に訪問される場所。
words.example: We spent the summer at a beach resort.

words.englishDefinition: The actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人あるいはグループに割り当てられたり、必要とされたり、期待されたりする行動や活動。
words.example: I think that we have a role to play.

words.englishDefinition: A long continuous strip (usually running horizontally)
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い連続した一片（通常、水平に走る）。
words.example: Our team has now lost three games in a row.

words.japanese: 太りすぎの、重量超過の
words.englishDefinition: weighing more than an expected or allowed amount
words.japaneseExplanation: 基準や許容範囲より重いこと。人にも荷物にも使う。
words.example: My suitcase was overweight, so I removed a few books.

words.englishDefinition: Causing physical or psychological pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的、または精神的な痛みを引き起こすさま。
words.example: I feel sick and painful. I feel hot and cold.

words.englishDefinition: Enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 穏やかな気持ちで辛い境遇に耐える、もしくはそのような我慢強さが特徴の。
words.example: Please be patient with me today.

words.englishDefinition: Concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
words.japaneseExplanation: ある人物または、その私的生活と人物像に影響を与えるまたは、それらの関する。
words.example: I have something personal to tell you after the dinner.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics
words.japaneseExplanation: 物体とエネルギーを扱う科学に関係する。特に物理学。
words.example: We cannot ask anything about age or physical problems.

words.englishDefinition: Affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜びを与えるさま。あなたの趣味または好みと調和してあること。
words.example: We went to the party and had a pleasant time.

words.englishDefinition: Showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 態度、話し方、振舞いなどにおいて、他人への敬意を示すさま。
words.example: You cannot be too polite when you meet the president.

words.englishDefinition: hopeful or confident; expressing agreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 前向きで希望を持つことや、肯定的な態度。
words.example: She stayed positive even when the work was difficult.

words.englishDefinition: Engaged in by members of a profession
words.japaneseExplanation: 専門職のメンバーが従事している。
words.example: You play the guitar quite like a professional, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: Done or occurring in a brief period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 短時間に行われる、または発生する。
words.example: I hope that I will receive a rapid response.

words.englishDefinition: Being or reflecting the essential or genuine character of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの本質または本当の特性の、またはそれを示す。
words.example: I had no real idea what it looked like.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of or requiring responsibility or trust; or held accountable
words.japaneseExplanation: 責任または信用に値する、あるいは、責任または信用を要求する。または責任があるとされる。
words.example: I can't be held responsible.

words.englishDefinition: Having or caused by an irregular surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 不規則な表面を持つ、または、不規則な表面に引き起こされる。
words.example: I have a rough idea what needs to be done.

words.englishDefinition: An implement that has hairs or bristles firmly set into a handle
words.japaneseExplanation: 毛または剛毛が取手に堅くつけられている道具。
words.example: I felt the brush of her hand against me.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo combustion
words.japaneseExplanation: 燃焼を経る。
words.example: I didn't think the house would burn down so quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Go after with the intent to catch
words.japaneseExplanation: 捕らえる目的で追いかける。
words.example: We knew that the dog would chase the cat.

words.japanese: と主張する、を要求する
words.englishDefinition: Assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing
words.japaneseExplanation: 強く断言する、または主張する。真実または存在する状態。
words.example: I claim that is not true.

words.japanese: せる 連絡を取る(with〜)、伝える(to〜)
words.englishDefinition: Transmit information
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を伝達する。
words.example: I want to be able to communicate in French.

words.japanese: わせる競争する、匹敵する
words.englishDefinition: Compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かのために競う。競技に参加する。
words.example: We used to compete against each other in college.

words.englishDefinition: Express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 苦情、不満、不快または不幸を表現する。
words.example: I actually have a lot to complain about in my life.

words.englishDefinition: Direct one's attention on something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに注意を向ける。
words.example: You must concentrate your attention on what you are doing.

words.englishDefinition: Something that interests you because it is important or affects you
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分にとって重要、あるいは影響があるために興味を持たせるもの。
words.example: How does this concern you?

words.englishDefinition: Assemble without order or sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 順序または分別なく集まる。
words.example: I want to be understood. I don't want to confuse anyone.

words.englishDefinition: Connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つ、それ以上のものをつなげる、固める一緒にする。
words.example: Do you feel like you cannot connect with other people?

words.englishDefinition: to be made up of particular things
words.japaneseExplanation: consist of で、何から構成されているかを表す。
words.example: The course consists of ten weekly lessons.

words.englishDefinition: Provide a cure for, make healthy again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び健康にするよう、治療する。
words.example: You think that you can cure yourself, don't you?

words.japanese: 敷物、小さなじゅうたん
words.englishDefinition: Floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)
words.japaneseExplanation: 厚い重い布地（通常けばまたはパイル織物）からなる床カバー。
words.example: Do you have the stuff you need to make the rug?

words.englishDefinition: Any member of a ship's crew
words.japaneseExplanation: 船の乗組員のメンバー。
words.example: I wouldn't like to be a sailor because I'm afraid of water.

words.englishDefinition: A general conscious awareness
words.japaneseExplanation: 意識されていること全般。
words.example: I get the sense that we speak the same language.

words.englishDefinition: The property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが予測または必要より少ないときの、その少ない分であることの特質。
words.example: There is never a shortage of things to do here.

words.englishDefinition: Any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message
words.japaneseExplanation: メッセージを符号化する非言語的な行動またはジェスチャーの総称。
words.example: What are you saying? I cannot hear, the signal here is too bad.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being silent (as when no one is speaking)
words.japaneseExplanation: 静かな状況（例えば、話し声がしない状況）。
words.example: I spoke because I could no longer hold my silence.

words.englishDefinition: The piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがある（予定の）土地の区画。
words.example: I just started using this site a little while ago.

words.englishDefinition: A natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch
words.japaneseExplanation: 体を保護する生まれながら備える覆いで、触覚を持つ場所。
words.example: I don't care what the color of your skin is.

words.englishDefinition: The part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
words.japaneseExplanation: 腐植土や分解した岩石から成る地表の一部。
words.example: It's difficult to grow anything in this soil.

words.englishDefinition: An enlisted man or woman who serves in an army
words.japaneseExplanation: 軍に勤める男性または女性の下士官兵。
words.example: You look a little young to be a soldier.

words.englishDefinition: A fundamental emotional and activating principle determining one's character
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の性格を決定づける感情と行動の基本的原理。
words.example: My body is old but my spirit is young.

words.englishDefinition: Be discharged in sprays of liquid
words.japaneseExplanation: 液体のスプレーで放出される。
words.example: We must spray them with cold water.

words.englishDefinition: The way something is with respect to its main attributes
words.japaneseExplanation: その主要な特性に注目したときのある物のあり方。
words.example: You must take his state of health into account.

words.englishDefinition: Having a circular shape
words.japaneseExplanation: 円形をしているさま。
words.example: We have snow on the mountain all the year round.

words.englishDefinition: Provoking fear terror
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐怖をおぼえさせる。
words.example: We watched a scary movie last night.

words.englishDefinition: Ending in a sharp point
words.japaneseExplanation: 鋭い点の結末。
words.example: I was here at 10 sharp, but you weren't.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking self-confidence
words.japaneseExplanation: 自信がないさま。
words.example: I was very shy when I was a kid.

words.englishDefinition: Having an agreeably pungent taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 快い刺激的な味のある。
words.example: I want to eat something that's not hot and spicy.

words.englishDefinition: A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較の基準。他のものとの評価をするための参考。
words.example: We must either set the standard or lose our cool.

words.englishDefinition: Not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 特にふるまいにおける変更または変化への対象ではない。
words.example: You need to find yourself a steady job.

words.japanese: ストレスの原因となる
words.englishDefinition: Extremely irritating to the nerves
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に神経に障る。
words.example: We have a stressful day ahead of us.

words.englishDefinition: (of rules) stringently enforced
words.japaneseExplanation: （規則について）厳しく実施される。
words.example: We have very strict rules about that.

words.englishDefinition: Pleasing to the sense of taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 味覚が良い。
words.example: I like to talk about tasty food with my friends.

words.englishDefinition: Characterizing or showing skill in or specialized knowledge of applied arts and sciences
words.japaneseExplanation: 応用人文科学の技術と特殊知識に特徴のあるまたはそれらを示す。
words.example: You need technical knowledge to understand how this system works.

words.englishDefinition: Causing fear or dread or terror
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れまたは不安または恐怖を引き起こすさま。
words.example: We woke to terrible news this morning.

words.englishDefinition: Not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
words.japaneseExplanation: 薄くない。特定の厚みの、または、1つの表面から正反対の通常3次元の固体の比較的大きな範囲の。
words.example: I cannot finish reading this thick book in a week.

words.englishDefinition: An interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つながりの出来事が再び起きるまでの間隔。
words.example: I hope to break that cycle with my own children.

words.englishDefinition: Declare untrue; contradict
words.japaneseExplanation: 虚偽であると宣言する。否定する。
words.example: You can't deny the fact that she had a hand in it.

words.englishDefinition: Give a description of
words.japaneseExplanation: 描写を行う。
words.example: How do you think that your friends would describe you?

words.englishDefinition: To show, make visible or apparent
words.japaneseExplanation: 見せるために、可視化する、またはか明らかにする。
words.example: You all display similar behavior.

words.englishDefinition: Separate into parts or portions
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分や部分に分かれる。
words.example: I thought you were going to divide up work.

words.englishDefinition: Give an education to
words.japaneseExplanation: 教育を与える。
words.example: We need to educate our children.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious
words.japaneseExplanation: 決まり悪くさせる。自意識が強いと感じさせる。
words.example: I feel embarrassed when I speak in front of people.

words.englishDefinition: Engage or hire for work
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
words.example: I will employ the girl, because she can speak French.

words.japanese: をするもてなす、楽しませる
words.englishDefinition: Provide entertainment for
words.japaneseExplanation: エンターテイメントを提供する。
words.example: I need to entertain myself with something.

words.englishDefinition: Run away from confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁から逃げる。
words.example: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

words.englishDefinition: Have an existence, be extant
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在を持つ、存在する。
words.example: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.

words.englishDefinition: Extend in one or more directions
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つまたはそれ以上の方向に伸ばす。
words.example: Our company wants to expand into a new market.

words.englishDefinition: Travel to or penetrate into
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行するか、侵入する。
words.example: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.

words.englishDefinition: An idea that is suggested
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案される考え。
words.example: I realize I'm new here, but I have a suggestion.

words.englishDefinition: The first light of day
words.japaneseExplanation: 日の出。
words.example: We got up early in order to see the sunrise.

words.englishDefinition: A practical method or art applied to some particular task
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の仕事に応用する、実践的な方法または技巧。
words.example: I wonder what the advantage of this technique is.

words.englishDefinition: a mark left by movement; a path for running
words.japaneseExplanation: 移動による跡や、走るためのコース。
words.example: We found animal tracks in the snow.

words.japanese: 船旅、 (ゆったりした長い)旅
words.englishDefinition: An act of traveling by water
words.japaneseExplanation: 船により旅行する行為。
words.example: My life is a voyage of discovery.

words.englishDefinition: A pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money
words.japaneseExplanation: 書類と紙幣を保持するためのポケットサイズのケース。
words.example: How much money do you have in your wallet right now?

words.englishDefinition: The vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity
words.japaneseExplanation: 重力による質量によってはたらきかけられた垂直の力。
words.example: I think it's time for me to lose some weight.

words.englishDefinition: A wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)
words.japaneseExplanation: 野性的で興奮させるような仕事（必ずしも合法的であるというわけではない）。
words.example: I want to go on an adventure.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who pursues a study or sport as a pastime
words.japaneseExplanation: 娯楽として研究またはスポーツを継続する誰か。
words.example: I was still an amateur at that time.

words.englishDefinition: Someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が系統を引く（通常、祖父母よりも遠い）人。
words.example: How do you know your ancestors even lived where you do now?

words.englishDefinition: A tank or pool or bowl filled with water for keeping live fish and underwater animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きた魚と水中の動物を維持しておく水のあるタンク、プールまたは鉢。
words.example: I only have three fish in my aquarium now.

words.englishDefinition: A contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 議論のある言語行為。強い意見の相違がある論争。
words.example: I wouldn't get involved in their argument.

words.englishDefinition: A person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 要求の実現、または努力や目標の推進に貢献する人。
words.example: I need an assistant who speaks French.

words.englishDefinition: (of hair) neat and tidy
words.japaneseExplanation: （毛髪について）きちんとしていて整った。
words.example: I always keep my room as tidy as I can.

words.englishDefinition: Exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category
words.japaneseExplanation: グループまたは種類またはカテゴリーを確認する特性または特徴を示すさま。
words.example: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.

words.japanese: 親しみのない、不親切な
words.englishDefinition: Not friendly
words.japaneseExplanation: 友好的でない。
words.example: Can you figure out why the boss is so unfriendly this week?

words.englishDefinition: Not known to exist
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在することを知られていない。
words.example: I regret to say that this is unknown to me.

words.englishDefinition: Not likely to be true or to occur or to have occurred
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実でなさそうな、起こりそうにない、起こりそうになかった。
words.example: I know that it's highly unlikely that anyone knows me.

words.englishDefinition: Having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
words.japaneseExplanation: 有効利用がない、あるいは役立つ機能をすることにおいて無能である。
words.example: I wish I had not bought such a useless thing.

words.englishDefinition: Acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな力、エネルギーまたは激しい感情を持って行動する、あるいはそれらを特徴とする、あるいはそれらに起因するさま。
words.example: You must be a very violent guy.

words.englishDefinition: having a particular value or being useful enough
words.japaneseExplanation: 価値があること。worth doing で「〜する価値がある」。
words.example: This museum is definitely worth a visit.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by energetic activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 精力的な活動によって特徴づけられる。
words.example: I think it takes a while to become active.

words.englishDefinition: Surprising greatly
words.japaneseExplanation: 大いに驚かすさま。
words.example: How amazing that your mother speaks six languages!

words.englishDefinition: (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth ; strictly correct
words.japaneseExplanation: （考え、イメージ、表象、表現について）事実または真実に対して完全な一致によって特徴づけられる。厳密に訂正する。
words.example: I don't know the exact place that I was born.

words.englishDefinition: Applying to all or most members of a category or group
words.japaneseExplanation: カテゴリやグループのすべてかほとんどの構成要素に適用するさま。
words.example: I love all animals in general.

words.englishDefinition: Being or characteristic of a single thing or person
words.japaneseExplanation: 一つのものまたは人であること、の特徴。
words.example: We must respect the will of the individual.

words.englishDefinition: The front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear
words.japaneseExplanation: 額から顎、耳から耳までの人頭の前部。
words.example: You should have seen her face when I said that.

words.englishDefinition: Gleam or glow intermittently
words.japaneseExplanation: 断続的に輝く。
words.example: At this moment, all his past life seemed to flash across his mind.

words.englishDefinition: Be in motion due to some air or water current
words.japaneseExplanation: 微風または水流によって動いている。
words.example: I love to float on the water.

words.englishDefinition: Bend or lay so that one part covers the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 一つの部分が他の部分を覆うように曲げるあるいは置く。
words.example: How many times have I told you to fold your clothes?

words.englishDefinition: Put in effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 実施する。
words.example: I need time to fulfill my dreams.

words.englishDefinition: A person who keeps watch over something or someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 物や人を見張る人。
words.example: I can't let my guard down when I'm with you.

words.englishDefinition: Be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
words.japaneseExplanation: その任にある、それとして動く、あるいは処理する。
words.example: I thought that I could handle this, but I can't.

words.englishDefinition: The occurrence of a change for the worse
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪い方へ変化する出来事。
words.example: What is the harm in doing that?

words.englishDefinition: Bring in from abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 外国から持ち込む。
words.example: Do you think we should import rice from the U.S.?

words.englishDefinition: Assert to be true
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であると主張する。
words.example: You will insist on your way all the way, won't you?

words.englishDefinition: Thrash about or strike out with the feet
words.japaneseExplanation: 足をばたばたさせる、進み出す。
words.example: My parents are going to kick me out of the house.

words.englishDefinition: The state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠けているか入手できないものを必要とする状態。
words.example: Our problem is more than just a lack of money.

words.englishDefinition: The means of connection between things linked in series
words.japaneseExplanation: 連続した物事同士の結びつき。
words.example: My friend sent me a link to this video.

words.englishDefinition: The mass of air surrounding the Earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球を取り巻く空気の塊。
words.example: I don't like the atmosphere of that school.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who waits on or tends to or attends to the needs of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の人の要求を待つ、気にかけるあるいは、世話をする誰か。
words.example: I showed the station attendant my ticket.

words.englishDefinition: Diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、こぶのある触覚と広い色の豊富な羽をもつ細い体を持つ昼行動性の昆虫。
words.example: Do you know how to catch a butterfly?

words.englishDefinition: A white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light; the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust; an important component of most plants and animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 明るい炎を上げて燃焼する白色の金属元素。地殻の中で5番目に豊富な要素。
words.example: Robert needs lots of calcium in his food.

words.englishDefinition: Domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age
words.japaneseExplanation: 性別や年齢に関わらずグループとしての家畜化したウシ科の動物。
words.example: I still need to feed the cattle.

words.englishDefinition: A joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの楽しい出来事を記念した特別のお祝いの機会。
words.example: I arrived late for the celebration.

words.englishDefinition: Demand payment
words.japaneseExplanation: 支払いを要求する。
words.example: I think you should charge $30 an hour.

words.englishDefinition: The science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions
words.japaneseExplanation: 成分の科学。物質の成分、性質、反応を扱う自然科学の分野。
words.example: We have a chemistry class together.

words.englishDefinition: The time of person's life when they are a child
words.japaneseExplanation: 子供である人生の一時期。
words.example: I wish I could get back to my childhood again.

words.englishDefinition: A native or naturalized member of a state or other political community
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国、または、別の政治共同体に属する生来の、または、帰化した構成員。
words.example: You want to become a citizen, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: A medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists
words.japaneseExplanation: 医療専門家のグループによって運営される医療機関。
words.example: How often do you go to a hospital or a clinic?

words.englishDefinition: The use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 見解、考え、情報などの非公式な交換のための言葉の使用。
words.example: My sister is having a conversation with her friends.

words.englishDefinition: A business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国でその会社定款が承認されている企業。
words.example: Damiano became the new face of the corporation.

words.englishDefinition: related to the energy released by changes in atoms
words.japaneseExplanation: 原子核や、原子核の変化から生じるエネルギーに関すること。
words.example: We discussed the advantages and disadvantages of nuclear power.

words.englishDefinition: Moving or facing away from each other
words.japaneseExplanation: お互いから避け、離れる。
words.example: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Free of extraneous elements of any kind
words.japaneseExplanation: いかなる種類の副次的要素がない。
words.example: We must be careful to drink only pure water.

words.englishDefinition: Not processed or subjected to analysis
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理されていない、または分析されていない。
words.example: I thought that you said you couldn't eat raw fish.

words.englishDefinition: Not excessive or extreme
words.japaneseExplanation: 過剰でないか極端ではない。
words.example: I know a good store with reasonable prices.

words.englishDefinition: Socially incorrect in behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会的に誤った行動。
words.example: You promised not to be rude to me any more.

words.englishDefinition: (sometimes followed by 'to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か特別な、特殊なまたは固有の物によって特徴づけられるまたはそれらに関連させる。
words.example: I must ask you to be more specific.

words.englishDefinition: showing poor judgment or little thought
words.japaneseExplanation: よく考えず、判断がよくないこと。人を直接こう呼ぶのは失礼。
words.example: It was a stupid mistake to leave my keys inside.

words.englishDefinition: Of high or superior quality or performance
words.japaneseExplanation: 高い、あるいは優れた品質か性能の。
words.example: You think you're superior to me in every way.

words.englishDefinition: Closely constrained or constricted or constricting
words.japaneseExplanation: 密接に、強制されるか、圧縮されるか、または圧縮する。
words.example: I like to feel his body tight against mine.

words.englishDefinition: The single one of its kind
words.japaneseExplanation: その種類の唯一のもの。
words.example: I didn't realize how unique that was until I grew up.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking kindness
words.japaneseExplanation: 親切さの欠乏。
words.example: I would not want her to remember me with unkind words.

words.englishDefinition: Having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に使用または交換にとって優れた物的価値または金銭的価値を持っているさま。
words.example: I am sorry to have taken up your valuable time.

words.englishDefinition: Fasten with a lock
words.japaneseExplanation: ロックで留める。
words.example: I forgot to lock my bike.

words.englishDefinition: Make lower or quieter
words.japaneseExplanation: より下げる、または、より静かにする。
words.example: Could you please lower the radio a bit?

words.englishDefinition: Of greater importance or stature or rank
words.japaneseExplanation: 更なる重要性、度合い、または地位の。
words.example: I decided to go to college to major in English.

words.englishDefinition: March in a procession
words.japaneseExplanation: 行列で行進する。
words.example: I can't wait to see you guys again in March.

words.englishDefinition: Be obedient to
words.japaneseExplanation: 従順である。
words.example: We should obey the law no matter what happens.

words.englishDefinition: Come to pass
words.japaneseExplanation: 起こる。
words.example: I don't expect that to occur.

words.englishDefinition: Win a victory over
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝利を収める。
words.example: You can overcome your problems.

words.englishDefinition: Address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer
words.japaneseExplanation: 神、預言者、聖人または崇拝の対象に直接問う。祈りを述べる。
words.example: I can teach you how to pray.

words.englishDefinition: Make believe with the intent to deceive
words.japaneseExplanation: だます意図でふりをする。
words.example: You don't need to pretend that you still like me.

words.englishDefinition: Speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way
words.japaneseExplanation: ある方法で話すか、発音するか、発する。
words.example: I cannot tell you how to pronounce this word.

words.englishDefinition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
words.example: I don't know how to prove that I love you.

words.englishDefinition: Impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
words.japaneseExplanation: 処罰を加える。処罰を課す。
words.example: We thought it wrong that you should punish him.

words.englishDefinition: Be fully aware or cognizant of
words.japaneseExplanation: 十分に認知しているまたは認識している。
words.example: I think it's important to realize that may not happen.

words.englishDefinition: A quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐怖心を見せることなく、苦痛や危険に立ち向かうことのできる精神のある性質。
words.example: I wish I had the courage to show my feelings.

words.englishDefinition: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律で罰せられる行為。通常悪い行為と見なされる。
words.example: I just said what I thought. Is that a crime?

words.englishDefinition: Large voracious aquatic reptile having a long snout with massive jaws and sharp teeth and a body covered with bony plates; of sluggish tropical waters
words.japaneseExplanation: 巨大な顎、鋭い歯、骨板で覆われている体のある長い口先を有する貧欲な水生は虫類。淀んだ熱帯の水域の。
words.example: How many teeth does a crocodile have?

words.englishDefinition: A large number of things or people considered together
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒になっていると見なされるたくさんの物や人。
words.example: I don't like having such a crowd of people around me.

words.englishDefinition: The condition of being susceptible to harm or injury
words.japaneseExplanation: 傷ついたり危害を受けやすい状況。
words.example: I couldn't leave you alone to face the danger by yourself.

words.englishDefinition: A collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn
words.japaneseExplanation: そこから結果を引き出せそうな事実の集まり。
words.example: I think we have all the data we need.

words.englishDefinition: the end of a person's or animal's life
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や動物の命が終わることを表す名詞。
words.example: The story describes the family's feelings after their grandfather's death.

words.englishDefinition: The act of making up your mind about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かについて心を決める行為。
words.example: We have to stay a decision until he comes back.

words.englishDefinition: The act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物の摂取（もしくは特定の食物の摂取）を制限する行為。
words.example: I have to lose weight, so I'm on a diet.

words.englishDefinition: The boundary of a surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面の境界。
words.example: We walked as far as the edge of the forest.

words.englishDefinition: A physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons
words.japaneseExplanation: 静止したあるいは動いている電子と陽子に関連した物理的現象。
words.example: You didn't forget to pay the electricity bill, did you?

words.englishDefinition: A sudden unforeseen crisis (usually involving danger) that requires immediate action
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然の思いがけない危機（通例危険を伴う）で緊急な行動をとる必要があること。
words.example: What number should I call in case of an emergency?

words.englishDefinition: Any strong feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い気持ちの総称。
words.example: Her emotion was too strong for words.

words.englishDefinition: Of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図的に整列しているが統一性に欠ける多くの異なった種類。
words.example: I really like studying various languages at the same time.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of being seen; or open to easy view
words.japaneseExplanation: 見ることができる。つまり容易に見ることができる。
words.example: There were a lot of stars visible in the sky.

words.englishDefinition: Having or prompted by wisdom or discernment
words.japaneseExplanation: 知恵または認識によって所有している、または引き起こされる。
words.example: I don't think it would be wise to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Almost not
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんどない。
words.example: I don't like fish very much and hardly ever eat it.

words.japanese: 願わくは、うまくいけば
words.englishDefinition: It is hoped
words.japaneseExplanation: それは望まれる。
words.example: Hopefully, the weather will be just like today.

words.englishDefinition: In the recent past
words.japaneseExplanation: 最近において。
words.example: I haven't been feeling well lately.

words.englishDefinition: For the most part
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分。
words.example: My success was mainly due to your help.

words.englishDefinition: In large part; mainly or chiefly
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分において。主に、または大方。
words.example: I mostly do not want to think about anything anymore.

words.englishDefinition: In such a manner as could not be otherwise
words.japaneseExplanation: そうでなかっはずがないような風な態度で。
words.example: We have to do everything on this list, but not necessarily in this order.

words.englishDefinition: In the right manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しい方法で。
words.example: I can't hear you properly. Please speak more slowly.

words.englishDefinition: To some (great or small) extent
words.japaneseExplanation: ある（多い、または、少ない）程度において。
words.example: I don't feel good or rather, I feel terrible.

words.englishDefinition: In secrecy; not openly
words.japaneseExplanation: 秘密に。公然とでなく。
words.example: What have you two been secretly up to?

words.englishDefinition: In the near future
words.japaneseExplanation: 近い将来に。
words.example: We will be taking off shortly.
