words.englishDefinition: Seek information from
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を集める。
words.example: I can refer you to a good book on this subject.

words.englishDefinition: To throw or bend back (from a surface)
words.japaneseExplanation: 背中（表面から）を放り投げるあるいは、曲げる。
words.example: I need a little time to reflect upon it.

words.englishDefinition: Reject with contempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽蔑して拒絶する。
words.example: I do not want to reject this claim.

words.englishDefinition: Put in the mind of someone
words.japaneseExplanation: だれかの心の中に入れる。
words.example: Please remind me of the time of the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Express the need or desire for; ask for
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性かは欲求を表わす。要求する。
words.example: I have a serious request to make of you.

words.englishDefinition: React verbally
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で反応する。
words.example: I didn't know how to respond to that question.

words.englishDefinition: Force, take, or pull apart
words.japaneseExplanation: 強制的に分ける、分解する、あるいは引き離す。
words.example: I don't want to separate myself from the team.

words.englishDefinition: Shake (a body part) to communicate a greeting, feeling, or cognitive state
words.japaneseExplanation: （体の一部）を揺らして、挨拶、感情、または認識状態を伝える。
words.example: I have to shake hands with the President.

words.englishDefinition: Fire a shot
words.japaneseExplanation: 弾丸を発射する。
words.example: You seem to shoot as well as your father does.

words.englishDefinition: Fall or descend to a lower place or level
words.japaneseExplanation: 低い場所、または高さかがむ、あるいは落ちる。
words.example: I wanted to sink through the floor.

words.englishDefinition: Bypass
words.japaneseExplanation: 無視する。
words.example: I intend to skip lunch for a week starting today.

words.englishDefinition: Move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 斜めに、または横に動く、通常、コントロールされない状態で。
words.example: Can you slide in those shoes?

words.englishDefinition: Become more focus on an area of activity or field of study
words.japaneseExplanation: 活動分野または研究対象によりもっと集中する。
words.example: What did you specialize in at university?

words.englishDefinition: The basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union (introduced in 1999); in 2002 twelve European nations (Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Ireland, Greece, Austria, Finland) adopted the euro as their basic unit of money and abandoned their traditional currencies
words.japaneseExplanation: ヨーロッパ連合のほとんどのメンバーの基本通貨単位（1999年に導入された）。2002年に、12のヨーロッパの国（ドイツ、フランス、ベルギー、ルクセンブルクオランダ、イタリア、スペイン、ポルトガル、アイルランド、ギリシア、オーストリア、フィンランド）が、それらのお金の原単位としてユーロを導入して、それらの伝統的な通貨を捨てました。
words.example: Can you give me a euro?

words.englishDefinition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
words.example: We felt happy when the examination was over.

words.englishDefinition: A statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 関連した構造、作業、あるいは事情などを述べることによって、理解できるようにする声明。
words.example: I would never have found as short an explanation.

words.englishDefinition: A strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の運命を支配する超自然的な力、または能力への強い確信。
words.example: Our faith is very strong.

words.englishDefinition: A rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体の体温が上がること。しばしば感染症の症状。
words.example: I had a little bit of a fever this morning.

words.englishDefinition: A small portable battery-powered electric lamp
words.japaneseExplanation: 携帯用の小さい電池式のランプ。
words.example: You won't be able to see anything without a flashlight.

words.englishDefinition: The hard structure (bones and cartilages) that provides a frame for the body of an animal
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物の身体の枠組みを提供する堅い構造物（骨と軟骨）。
words.example: We need a frame for this picture.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that can be consumed to produce energy
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを生み出すために消費される物質。
words.example: How much fuel do you need?

words.englishDefinition: Food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)
words.japaneseExplanation: （台所などから）捨てられる食べ物。
words.example: I saw a man yesterday eating from a garbage can.

words.englishDefinition: The state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it
words.japaneseExplanation: 計画が達成することを目的とし、それを達成するために意図される行動を終わらせる出来事の状態。
words.example: We won't give up when we've almost reached the goal.

words.englishDefinition: Compatibility in opinion and action
words.japaneseExplanation: 意見や行動での適合性。
words.example: My dog and cat live in harmony with each other.

words.englishDefinition: A person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
words.japaneseExplanation: 歴史を研究して執筆し大家となる人。
words.example: I see myself as a historian.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being honored
words.japaneseExplanation: 名誉を与えられていること。
words.example: I can't tell you what an honor this is.

words.englishDefinition: With sincerity; without pretense
words.japaneseExplanation: 誠実さをもって。見せかけなしで。
words.example: I sincerely hope that never happens to him.

words.englishDefinition: Without deviation
words.japaneseExplanation: 逸脱なしで。
words.example: I went straight to the post office.

words.englishDefinition: With strength or in a strong manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 強さがあり、または強い方法で。
words.example: I felt very strongly about it.

words.englishDefinition: In an amazing manner; to everyone's surprise
words.japaneseExplanation: 驚いた様子で。皆が驚いたことに。
words.example: I got this used for surprisingly cheap.

words.japanese: それゆえに、したがって
words.englishDefinition: (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
words.japaneseExplanation: その事実または理由から、あるいは、結果として。
words.example: We are happy, and therefore we will go to the market.

words.englishDefinition: To a complete degree or to the full or entire extent ('whole' is often used informally for 'wholly')
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全な程度、一杯になるまで、または全範囲。
words.example: What you're telling me is totally different from what I heard from him.

words.englishDefinition: Without advance planning
words.japaneseExplanation: 事前計画なしで。
words.example: I accidentally locked my keys in the car.

words.englishDefinition: At this time or period; now
words.japaneseExplanation: この時あるいは期間に。今。
words.example: I live in Algeria and I'm currently in college.

words.englishDefinition: Continuing forever without end
words.japaneseExplanation: 果てしなく永遠に続くこと。
words.example: My dream man is endlessly playing hide-and-seek with me.

words.englishDefinition: To an extreme degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 極端に。
words.example: I caught the last train because I walked extremely quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
words.japaneseExplanation: 遅れ、または躊躇なしで。介入する時間なしで。
words.example: I wrote to him that he needs to come immediately.

words.englishDefinition: Advancing in amount or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 量または強さが進歩すること。
words.example: I increasingly need your help.

words.englishDefinition: In truth (often tends to intensify)
words.japaneseExplanation: 実は（しばしば強調につながる）。
words.example: You believe he is a good doctor, and he is indeed.

words.englishDefinition: Flow, run or fall out and become lost
words.japaneseExplanation: 流れる、抜け落ちてそしてなくなる。
words.example: I am afraid he is going to spill the beans.

words.englishDefinition: Stick to firmly
words.japaneseExplanation: しっかり執着。
words.example: We three will stick together.

words.englishDefinition: Extend one's limbs or muscles, or the entire body
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の手足または筋肉または体の全体を伸ばす。
words.example: We got out of the car to stretch our legs.

words.japanese: 成功する、を成し遂げる
words.englishDefinition: Attain success or reach a desired goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功を収めるか、または望んでいる目標に達する。
words.example: We had expected that you would succeed this time.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo or be subjected to
words.japaneseExplanation: 耐える、またはさらされる。
words.example: I don't see why we should have to suffer.

words.englishDefinition: Give something useful or necessary to
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを役に立つまたは必要であるものにする。
words.example: The store can supply us with anything we need.

words.englishDefinition: Harass with persistent criticism or carping
words.japaneseExplanation: しつこい批評または文句で困らせる。
words.example: My mom used to tease me all the time about it.

words.englishDefinition: Have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをするまたは何かになる傾向のあるまたはその気質のある。何かをしがちな。
words.example: I would tend to agree with that.

words.englishDefinition: Restate (words) from one language into another language
words.japaneseExplanation: ある言語から他の言語へ（言葉を）言い換える。
words.example: I would like you to translate this book into English.

words.englishDefinition: Twist suddenly so as to sprain
words.japaneseExplanation: 捻挫するように突然ねじる。
words.example: You always twist what I say.

words.englishDefinition: Make wider
words.japaneseExplanation: より広くする。
words.example: They're trying to widen the road to the village.

words.englishDefinition: Utter a sudden loud cry
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然、大きい泣き声を発する。
words.example: You don't need to yell. I can hear you just fine.

words.japanese: 感謝する、正しく評価する
words.englishDefinition: Recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
words.japaneseExplanation: 感謝を表彰する。感謝する。
words.example: I would appreciate any information you can send to us.

words.englishDefinition: The ability to form mental images of things or events
words.japaneseExplanation: 物や出来事の心的イメージを形成する能力。
words.example: My world is as big or as small as my imagination.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being important and worthy of note
words.japaneseExplanation: 重要で、注目に値するという特質。
words.example: Do you understand the importance of what you are saying?

words.englishDefinition: Causing something without any direct or apparent effort
words.japaneseExplanation: いかなる直接的または明白な努力なしに、何かを引き起こすこと。
words.example: I believe in the influence of the stars on our lives.

words.englishDefinition: A sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かあるいは何かにかかわり合いたいという関心と好奇心。
words.example: I don't think I'd be that interested in doing that.

words.englishDefinition: Formally making a person known to another or to the public
words.japaneseExplanation: 他人あるいは世間に正式に知らせること。
words.example: You should read the introduction at the beginning of the book.

words.englishDefinition: A professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
words.japaneseExplanation: 弁護士の権限を与えられた専門家。訴訟を行ったり法律上の助言を与えたりする。
words.example: My father-in-law is a lawyer.

words.japanese: 免許証、 (公的機関の)許可
words.englishDefinition: A legal document giving official permission to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをする公式の許可を与える法律文書。
words.example: Do you have a license to do that?

words.englishDefinition: The period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
words.japaneseExplanation: （誕生と死の間のように）何かが機能している期間。
words.example: I got the chance of a lifetime, and I took it.

words.englishDefinition: Creative writing of recognized artistic value
words.japaneseExplanation: 芸術的価値を認められた創作文書。
words.example: Could you lend me the literature homework?

words.englishDefinition: A large entrance or reception room or area
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きい入り口、応接室または地域。
words.example: I have a friend waiting for me in the lobby.

words.englishDefinition: A point or extent in space
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間内での点あるいは範囲。
words.example: What is the location of the country?

words.japanese: 家事をする使用人、客室清掃係
words.englishDefinition: A female domestic
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性の召使い。
words.example: Please have the maid carry it to my room.

words.englishDefinition: Mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers; usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area; a modern version of the traditional marketplace
words.japaneseExplanation: 有名な会社の店の注意ぶかく配置された複合施設で成る商業施設。通常、レストランと近くの駐車場を含む。
words.example: We spent a great day at the mall.

words.englishDefinition: Despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
words.japaneseExplanation: それと反対（通常、譲歩に続く）な何にもかかわらずでも。
words.example: I slept for ten hours, nevertheless I'm still tired.

words.englishDefinition: Under normal conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の状態で。
words.example: How much water do you normally drink in a day?

words.englishDefinition: Unmistakably ('plain' is often used informally for 'plainly')
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違いなく。
words.example: I obviously did something wrong, but I don't know what.

words.englishDefinition: Not often
words.japaneseExplanation: めったにない。
words.example: We rarely met each other.

words.englishDefinition: To a small degree or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さい程度か範囲に。
words.example: I speak French only slightly better than I speak English.

words.englishDefinition: Used as intensifiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 強意語として使われる。
words.example: I can't say I'm terribly proud of what I did.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who controls resources and expenditures
words.japaneseExplanation: 資産と支出を管理する人。
words.example: I cannot call the manager now. It's too late.

words.japanese: 重大である、問題になる
words.englishDefinition: Have weight; have import, carry weight
words.japaneseExplanation: 重荷になる。重要で、重きを増す。
words.example: You might say that doesn't matter very much, but actually it does.

words.englishDefinition: ways of sharing news and information with the public
words.japaneseExplanation: 新聞、テレビ、インターネットなど情報を伝える媒体。
words.example: Social media helps me keep in touch with friends.

words.englishDefinition: A state of confusion and disorderliness
words.japaneseExplanation: 乱雑で無秩序である状態。
words.example: I was making a mess in my house.

words.englishDefinition: A person who carries a message
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝言を運ぶ人。
words.example: I call them every day on Messenger.

words.englishDefinition: Two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 雌は人間と動物の皮膚を突き刺し血を吸うための長い吻を持つ双翅目の昆虫。
words.example: I can't see the mosquito, I can only hear it.

words.englishDefinition: People having common origins or traditions and often comprising a nation
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通の起源または伝統を持ち、しばしば国家を構成しているる人々。
words.example: Can you tell me your nationality?

words.englishDefinition: Take into custody
words.japaneseExplanation: 保護する。
words.example: I doubt that the police are going to arrest Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Give a beating to; subject to a beating, either as a punishment or as an act of aggression
words.japaneseExplanation: 殴りつける。罰則としてまたは攻撃行為としてのいづれかで暴力にあう。
words.example: I can beat him hands down.

words.englishDefinition: To grip, cut off, or tear with or as if with the teeth or jaws
words.japaneseExplanation: つかむか、中断するか、または引き裂く、歯か顎で。
words.example: I will bite off just a little bit.

words.englishDefinition: Force out or release suddenly and often violently something pent up
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然にそして抑圧された何かをしばしば激しく強制的に外に出す、あるいは放出する。
words.example: I want to burst into tears.

words.englishDefinition: Put or add together
words.japaneseExplanation: まとめる、あるいは足し合わせる。
words.example: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.

words.englishDefinition: Give careful consideration to
words.japaneseExplanation: よく考える、慎重審議する。
words.example: Please give me a little more time to consider that.

words.englishDefinition: Fall or come down violently
words.japaneseExplanation: 落ちる、あるいは激しく下降する。
words.example: What caused the plane to crash?

words.englishDefinition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
words.example: I don't know how to demonstrate it, since it's too obvious!

words.japanese: 次第である、当てにする
words.englishDefinition: Be contingent upon (something that is elided)
words.japaneseExplanation: （削除されたもの）次第である。
words.example: I need to know that I can depend on you.

words.englishDefinition: Observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
words.japaneseExplanation: 観察、確かめる、入念に調べるまたは検査する。
words.example: I want to examine you again tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Give expression to
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現をする。
words.example: I can't find the word to express what I feel.

words.englishDefinition: Win something through one's efforts
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
words.example: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

words.englishDefinition: Put into a certain place or abstract location
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の場所または抽象的な場所に置く。
words.example: I would lay down my life for you.

words.englishDefinition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
words.example: I became unable to maintain my self-control.

words.englishDefinition: Make reference to
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及を行う。
words.example: I am not going to mention the name of the teacher.

words.japanese: 提案する、結婚を申し込む
words.englishDefinition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
words.example: I have made up my mind to propose to her.

words.japanese: 元気にする、新たにする
words.englishDefinition: to make someone feel less tired or renew something
words.japaneseExplanation: 疲れを和らげたり、新しい状態にしたりすること。
words.example: A short walk outside helps refresh my mind.

words.englishDefinition: Feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
words.japaneseExplanation: 悔恨を感じる。遺憾に感じる。
words.example: I have a feeling I'm going to regret this later.

words.englishDefinition: Release, as from one's grip
words.japaneseExplanation: 掴んでいるものなどを、解放する。
words.example: I told him not to release the rope, but he let it go.

words.englishDefinition: Show respect towards
words.japaneseExplanation: 尊敬を示す。
words.example: You should respect the rules your parents set for you.

words.englishDefinition: The guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所から別の場所へ船や飛行機を案内すること。
words.example: Damiano refused to believe that he made a mistake in the navigation.

words.englishDefinition: Anything indispensable
words.japaneseExplanation: 不可欠な何でも。
words.example: We understand the necessity of studying.

words.englishDefinition: A surrounding or nearby region
words.japaneseExplanation: 周辺の地域、または、近隣の地域。
words.example: You will find your bicycle somewhere in the neighborhood of the station.

words.englishDefinition: A personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
words.japaneseExplanation: 証拠または確証の基づかない個人的信条または判断。
words.example: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.

words.englishDefinition: The place where something begins, where it springs into being
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが生まれて、始まる場所。
words.example: I would like to know your origin.

words.englishDefinition: An associate in an activity or endeavor or sphere of common interest
words.japaneseExplanation: ある行動や試みや分野において共通の関心を持った仲間。
words.example: I live in Boston with a partner and three cats.

words.englishDefinition: Interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
words.japaneseExplanation: 継続前に活動を一時的に中断する。
words.example: You need to pause between each sentence.

words.englishDefinition: A proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体に対する比率（通常、百分率）。
words.example: I agree one hundred percent with my opinion. Why don't you?

words.englishDefinition: A cushion to support the head of a sleeping person
words.japaneseExplanation: 寝ている人の頭を支えるためのクッション。
words.example: I shall sleep with your letter under my pillow tonight.

words.englishDefinition: Dish on which food is served or from which food is eaten
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物を出したり食べたりする皿。
words.example: We have enough on our plate at the office.

words.englishDefinition: A composition written in metrical feet forming rhythmical lines
words.japaneseExplanation: リズミカルな詩句を作る、韻脚で書かれた詩。
words.example: I have written many plays, but never a poem.

words.englishDefinition: A plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人あるいは社会的グループによって採用されている計画あるいは活動。
words.example: I think we need to change our policy on that.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く敬服され、受け入れられ、もてはやされる性質。
words.example: I have doubts about his popularity.

words.japanese: ポンド（重さ・通貨の単位）
words.englishDefinition: 16 ounces avoirdupois
words.japaneseExplanation: 16オンス。
words.example: I bought a pound of meat the other day.

words.englishDefinition: Express approval of
words.japaneseExplanation: 好意的な感情を表す。
words.example: You cannot praise a child enough for doing something well.

words.englishDefinition: The act of making something publicly available; presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを一般に公表する行為。ニュースまたは他の情報を放送あるいは印刷物で提示すること。
words.example: I prepared a presentation for this very lesson.

words.englishDefinition: The force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit)
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面の単位面積に働く力。パスカル（国際表示単位）またはダイン（CGS単位）で測定される。
words.example: I couldn't handle the pressure anymore and I gave up.

words.japanese: 私生活の秘密、プライバシー
words.englishDefinition: The quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の人の存在や視野から孤立する性質。
words.example: Do you mind? I need some privacy here.

words.japanese: (食品・原料など)加工処理する
words.englishDefinition: Subject to a process or treatment, with the aim of readying for some purpose, improving, or remedying a condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの目的のための準備、向上するため、または状態を改善することを伴う過程または処理を受けさせる。
words.example: I need some time to process what happened.

words.englishDefinition: Appraise critically
words.japaneseExplanation: 批判的に、評価する。
words.example: We need to review the case.

words.englishDefinition: Move upward
words.japaneseExplanation: 上方に動く。
words.example: We are waiting for the sun to rise.

words.englishDefinition: Try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of
words.japaneseExplanation: 見つけ、発見し、またはその存在を確定しようとする。
words.example: I don't need to seek their advice.

words.englishDefinition: Pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives
words.japaneseExplanation: 選ぶ、多くの選択肢から選ぶ。
words.example: You may select either one or the other.

words.englishDefinition: Move or walk in a swinging or swaying manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 動く、揺れるまたは揺れているように歩く。
words.example: My daughter loves to swing.

words.englishDefinition: Act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 協力して行うか、共通の目的または信念の下に結束する。
words.example: I would unite with anybody to do right, and with nobody to do wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Be subject to change in accordance with a variable
words.japaneseExplanation: 変数に従って変更される傾向がある。
words.example: You should try to vary your diet.

words.englishDefinition: Arrange or fold as a cover or protection
words.japaneseExplanation: 覆いまたは保護として調整するまたは包む。
words.example: Do you want me to wrap it up as a gift?

words.englishDefinition: Gradual improvement or growth or development
words.japaneseExplanation: 漸進的な改善または成長または発展。
words.example: I wonder if my boss is happy with my progress.

words.englishDefinition: The science of mental life
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神生活の科学。
words.example: My mother is a psychology teacher.

words.englishDefinition: A contest of speed
words.japaneseExplanation: スピードを争う競技。
words.example: I tried my best, but I still lost the race.

words.englishDefinition: A magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 単位時間と比較しての大きさまたは頻度。
words.example: They walked at the rate of three miles an hour.

words.englishDefinition: (chemistry) a process in which one or more substances are changed into others
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つ以上の物質が他の物に変わるという過程。
words.example: I could tell from your reaction that you were surprised.

words.englishDefinition: An abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの実体あるいは部分にともに属する、あるいは固有な抽象的実体。
words.example: What happened with your relation with him?

words.englishDefinition: Estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較により査定される。絶対でないか完全でない。
words.example: I have a relative who lives around here.

words.englishDefinition: Available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 財貨を生じる源。必要なときに引き出せる新しい、または貯蓄された供給源。
words.example: We don't have the resources we need.

words.englishDefinition: The act of coming together again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び集まる行為。
words.example: I will go to the reunion.

words.englishDefinition: Payment made in return for a service rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 提供されたサービスに対する支払い。
words.example: You told him that he should have a reward.

words.englishDefinition: A number that, when multiplied by itself some number of times, equals a given number
words.japaneseExplanation: それ自身を何乗かすると元の数になるような数。
words.example: We need to get to the root of the problem.

words.englishDefinition: Gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: （通例真実とうそを取り混ぜた）ゴシップが口コミで広まっていくこと。
words.example: I know better than to be believe such a rumor.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 定義された状況下において副作用が一部の抗体に起因しないことが確信されている状態。
words.example: I have to say, his safety plan is well thought-out.

words.englishDefinition: The place where some action occurs
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが起こった場所。
words.example: I went to the scene of the crime.

words.englishDefinition: Literary fantasy involving the imagined impact of science on society
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会に対する科学の想像上の衝撃を含んだ文学的なファンタジー。
words.example: I think that most old people don't understand about what science fiction is.

words.englishDefinition: A number that expresses the accomplishment of a team or an individual in a game or contest
words.japaneseExplanation: 試合やコンテストでのチームや個人の成績を表す数字。
words.example: What was the score of the game?

words.englishDefinition: The state of being free from danger or injury
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険または危害がない状態。
words.example: I didn't know that you worked for a security company.

words.englishDefinition: The act of choosing or selecting
words.japaneseExplanation: 選ぶ行為。
words.example: When you go back, the selection you made is canceled.

words.englishDefinition: A string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language
words.japaneseExplanation: 言語の文法規則を満たす一連の語。
words.example: How do I change the language of a sentence?

words.englishDefinition: An ability that has been acquired by training
words.japaneseExplanation: 訓練によって身につけた能力。
words.example: I don't have the skill needed to do that.

words.englishDefinition: a person who smokes tobacco
words.japaneseExplanation: たばこを吸う人を表す名詞。
words.example: The survey asked whether each person was a smoker.

words.englishDefinition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
words.japaneseExplanation: 異種交配できる分類群。
words.example: I had never before seen this species of fish.

words.englishDefinition: Predatory arachnid with eight legs, two poison fangs, two feelers, and usually two silk-spinning organs at the back end of the body; they spin silk to make cocoons for eggs or traps for prey
words.japaneseExplanation: 8本の脚、2本の毒牙、および2本の触角を持ち、通常は体の後部に糸を吐き出す2つの器官がある捕食性のクモ形類動物。彼らは糸を吐いて卵のための繭または獲物を捕るわなを作る。
words.example: How many legs does a spider have?

words.englishDefinition: A sculpture representing a human or animal
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間や動物を表した彫刻。
words.example: I never want to see that statue again.

words.englishDefinition: Reproducer in which two microphones feed two or more loudspeakers to give a three-dimensional effect to the sound
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つのマイクが音に三次元影響を与えるために2つ以上の拡声器を供給する再生装置。
words.example: Please turn down the stereo a little.

words.englishDefinition: An enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal; the principal organ of digestion
words.japaneseExplanation: 消化管の拡大し筋肉質の嚢状の器官。消化の主要な器官。
words.example: You should put something in your stomach before you go.

words.englishDefinition: The property of being physically or mentally strong
words.japaneseExplanation: 肉体的、または精神的に強い特性。
words.example: You want to give your strength and also your money.

words.englishDefinition: The outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
words.japaneseExplanation: 物体の外側の境界、または境界となるあるいはそれに似た物質の層。
words.example: I saw several fish swimming near the surface of the water.

words.englishDefinition: Natural abilities or qualities
words.japaneseExplanation: 天賦の才または特性。
words.example: You have a talent for making things right.

words.englishDefinition: A fellow member of a team
words.japaneseExplanation: チームの一員。
words.example: What do you think about your new teammate?

words.englishDefinition: The practical application of science to commerce or industry
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業または産業に対する科学の実用化。
words.example: We don't have the technology for that.

words.englishDefinition: The means whereby some act is accomplished
words.japaneseExplanation: それによって何かが達成される手段。
words.example: Do you know what this tool is used for?

words.englishDefinition: An ache localized in or around a tooth
words.japaneseExplanation: 歯か歯の周りの局部的な痛み。
words.example: I have a toothache, so I can't eat anything.

words.englishDefinition: The subject matter of a conversation or discussion
words.japaneseExplanation: 会話または議論の主題。
words.example: I didn't want to discuss that topic.

words.englishDefinition: A fact that has been verified
words.japaneseExplanation: 証明された事実。
words.example: I can't figure out why he didn't tell the truth.

words.englishDefinition: An open jar of glass or porcelain used as an ornament or to hold flowers
words.japaneseExplanation: 装飾や花を活けるのに使われるガラスや陶器の口の開いた壺。
words.example: I need a vase to put these flowers in.

words.englishDefinition: An unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの不利な状況に悩む不幸な人。
words.example: You don't have to be a victim.

words.englishDefinition: Annual or biennial grass having erect flower spikes and light brown grains
words.japaneseExplanation: 直立する穂状花序と明るい褐色の穀粒を持つ、一年生または二年生の草。
words.example: I have not eaten wheat in two months.

words.englishDefinition: The extent of something from side to side
words.japaneseExplanation: 端から端までの何かの範囲。
words.example: What is the width of this street?

words.englishDefinition: The action of accomplishing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを成し遂げる行為。
words.example: It is quite an achievement!

words.englishDefinition: The act of admitting someone to enter
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に入場を許す行為。
words.example: How much is the admission ticket?

words.englishDefinition: Passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores
words.japaneseExplanation: 観客席または車の座席の間、また商店で商品棚の間にある通路。
words.example: I had an aisle seat on the flight.

words.japanese: 感謝、正しく理解すること
words.englishDefinition: An expression of gratitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 感謝の態度を表明すること。
words.example: I have some appreciation of your problems.

words.englishDefinition: The act of arriving at a certain place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所に到達する行為。
words.example: Our train still needs to wait for the arrival of another train.

words.englishDefinition: A complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のさまでこうどうするための信条、感情、価値および気質を含む複雑な精神状態。
words.example: I hope to improve my attitude to work.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of arousing interest; being attractive or something that attracts
words.japaneseExplanation: 興味を刺激する質。魅力的であること、または人を引きつける物。
words.example: What you call love is nothing more than just attraction.

words.englishDefinition: Cases used to carry belongings when traveling
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行のとき持ち物を運ぶのに用いる箱。
words.example: I want to know when my baggage is going to arrive.

words.englishDefinition: Any cognitive content held as true
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実だと見做されている認知的内容。
words.example: My belief is that things will change for the better.

words.englishDefinition: The science that studies living organisms
words.japaneseExplanation: 生命体を研究する科学。
words.example: I was late and missed most of my biology class.

words.englishDefinition: The lower side of anything
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの下側の面。
words.example: Please write your name at the bottom of this paper.

words.englishDefinition: That part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
words.japaneseExplanation: すべての高度神経中枢を含む中枢神経系のその部分。頭蓋に包まれている。
words.example: I think that part of my brain died a long time ago.

words.englishDefinition: A division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant
words.japaneseExplanation: 茎が分裂したもの、または植物の主要な茎から生じる派生的な茎。
words.example: I don't think that that branch can support your weight.

words.englishDefinition: A series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end
words.japaneseExplanation: ある考えを推し進める、またはある目的に向かっていこうとする一連の活動。
words.example: How do you think that the campaign is going?

words.englishDefinition: A coding system used for transmitting messages requiring brevity or secrecy
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡潔さか秘密主義を必要とするメッセージを送るのに使用される記号化体系。
words.example: I have forgotten the code they gave me.

words.englishDefinition: A business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers
words.japaneseExplanation: 2社が顧客の取得をめぐって競う商業上の関係。
words.example: I think I'm doing quite well given the competition.

words.englishDefinition: A position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration
words.japaneseExplanation: 熟考の末に到達した立場、意見、または判断。
words.example: How did I reach this conclusion?

words.englishDefinition: A relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事または出来事の関連（例えば1つがもう一方を引き起こす、あるいは1つがもう一方と共通点を持つ）。
words.example: I have ten minutes to catch my connection.

words.englishDefinition: The human act of creating
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間が作成する行為。
words.example: Is fear a creation of the mind?

words.englishDefinition: The act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)
words.japaneseExplanation: （品物や郵便のような）何かを届けたり配布したりする行為。
words.example: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?

words.englishDefinition: A visual presentation showing how something works
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事の仕組みを視覚的に見せること。
words.example: Do you want a demonstration?

words.englishDefinition: The system of production and distribution and consumption
words.japaneseExplanation: 生産、流通、消費の制度。
words.example: I can't afford much because of the economy we are in.

words.englishDefinition: Expression without words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉のない表現。
words.example: I actually heard someone use this expression just this morning.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that contributes causally to a result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果に偶然結びつくもの。
words.example: I don't think that that's a factor.

words.englishDefinition: An act that fails
words.japaneseExplanation: 失敗する行為。
words.example: I will not talk about the failure of my project.

words.englishDefinition: Gathering of producers to promote business
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業促進のための生産者たちの集まり。
words.example: We paid a fair price for it.

words.englishDefinition: The sum charged for riding in a public conveyance
words.japaneseExplanation: 公共の乗物の利用に対する請求額。
words.example: How much is the fare on the bus?

words.englishDefinition: An imperfection in an object or machine
words.japaneseExplanation: 物または機械の欠陥。
words.example: You talk as if it's my fault.

words.englishDefinition: An emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger (usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight)
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の苦痛または危険を察した時の感情（通常、逃避または戦いを望む感情を伴う）。
words.example: My fear is more than my desire to try.

words.englishDefinition: A prominent attribute or aspect of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの顕著な面。
words.example: Please add this feature request.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) the six kinds of quarks
words.japaneseExplanation: 6種類のクォーク。
words.example: I prefer the flavor of fresh-water fish.

words.englishDefinition: Grow, progress, unfold, or evolve through a process of evolution, natural growth, differentiation, or a conducive environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 進化、自然の成長、分化、あるいは伝導性のある環境の過程を通じて、成長し、進歩し、展開し、または発展する。
words.example: We want to develop and make progress.

words.englishDefinition: To make better
words.japaneseExplanation: よりよくする。
words.example: I just want to improve as much as I can.

words.englishDefinition: Vulnerably delicate
words.japaneseExplanation: 傷つきやすく繊細な。
words.example: Could you put these fragile things in a safe place?

words.englishDefinition: A condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの出来事か活動に伴うか、または影響を及ぼす状態。
words.example: What would you do in this circumstance?

words.englishDefinition: Prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律で、あるいは公式であるか認められた規則によって禁止される。
words.example: I didn't know that what we were doing was illegal.

words.englishDefinition: Present for acceptance or rejection
words.japaneseExplanation: 承諾または拒絶を示す。
words.example: I was going to offer to buy you a drink.

words.englishDefinition: Stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 接触がないままでいる。離れた状態を維持する。
words.example: We took a back road to avoid the heavy traffic.

words.englishDefinition: The state of owing something (especially money)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（特に金銭）を借りている状態。
words.example: I went to pay off my debt at the bank.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of a region
words.japaneseExplanation: 領域の特性。
words.example: I eventually want to become regional manager.

words.englishDefinition: Detect with the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚で検出する。
words.example: I wonder if she will recognize me after all those years.

words.englishDefinition: Spend thoughtlessly; throw away
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽率に費やす。浪費する。
words.example: You must be careful not to waste time.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 宇宙のすべての塊の間の引力。特に、地球の表面付近の物体に対する地球の質量の引力。
words.example: I am well aware of the gravity of the situation.

words.englishDefinition: empty and available for someone to use
words.japaneseExplanation: 人が使っておらず、空いていること。
words.example: Is there a vacant seat near the window?

words.englishDefinition: Express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent
words.japaneseExplanation: 異論、抗議または批評を示す、または異議を唱える。
words.example: Do you think anyone would object if we did that?

words.englishDefinition: Examine and note the similarities or differences of
words.japaneseExplanation: 類似点または相違点を検討し留意する。
words.example: I don't think you should compare yourself to others.

words.englishDefinition: An important question that is in dispute and must be settled
words.japaneseExplanation: 論争の重要な論点で、解決しなければならないこと。
words.example: Could you share your honest opinion on this issue?

words.englishDefinition: A professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
words.japaneseExplanation: 弁護士の権限を与えられた専門家。訴訟を行ったり法律上の助言を与えたりする。
words.example: My father-in-law is a lawyer.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違いや欠点を見つけ、それらに注視する傾向に特徴的な。
words.example: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

words.englishDefinition: To consider or examine in speech or writing
words.japaneseExplanation: スピーチまたは文章で熟慮するまたは調査する。
words.example: We used to discuss everything and now we can't talk about anything.

words.englishDefinition: to produce young animals; to raise animals for breeding
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物が子を産むことや、繁殖させること。
words.example: Some birds breed here during the summer months.

words.englishDefinition: Any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
words.japaneseExplanation: 皮膚がほぼ毛で覆われている、温血脊椎動物。単孔類の小亜綱を除いて子供は生きたまま生まれミルクで育てられる。
words.example: What is the largest mammal in the world?

words.englishDefinition: Not often
words.japaneseExplanation: めったにない。
words.example: We often have to start again, but seldom from the beginning.

words.englishDefinition: Examine minutely or intensely
words.japaneseExplanation: 緻密にまた強烈に調べる。
words.example: I want you to scan this book.

words.englishDefinition: Request urgently and forcefully
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊急に、そして、力強く要請する。
words.example: I demand to see the manager.

words.englishDefinition: Any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
words.japaneseExplanation: 直感や推理よりも感覚を通じて知る状態や過程。
words.example: We have never managed to explain that phenomenon.

words.englishDefinition: Enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 穏やかな気持ちで辛い境遇に耐える、もしくはそのような我慢強さが特徴の。
words.example: Please be patient with me today.

words.englishDefinition: Win something through one's efforts
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
words.example: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

words.englishDefinition: Act against or in opposition to
words.japaneseExplanation: それに対して、あるいは反対して行う。
words.example: I hope you're not going to oppose me.

words.englishDefinition: The science of matter and energy and their interactions
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質とエネルギーとその相互作用の科学。
words.example: I cannot understand the physics teacher. I am completely lost!

words.englishDefinition: An authoritative rule
words.japaneseExplanation: 権威のある規則。
words.example: We should do away with this regulation.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
words.japaneseExplanation: 統一で特徴づけられる。単一体であるまたはそれに加わる。
words.example: You must be more united than ever.

words.englishDefinition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
words.example: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: The appearance of a place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所の外観。
words.example: I feel like I've seen this scenery somewhere before.

words.englishDefinition: A reminder of past events
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去の出来事を思い出させるもの。
words.example: I bought you a souvenir, but I ate it.

words.englishDefinition: Being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間または努力または実費を浪費することなく効果的であるさま。
words.example: I am not so efficient as I used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Give to a charity or good cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 慈善団体または立派な大義名分に与える。
words.example: What do I need to do to donate my blood?

words.englishDefinition: Extend in scope or range or area
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲、幅または領域が広がる。
words.example: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

words.englishDefinition: The environmental condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 環境条件。
words.example: I decided to be more aware of my surroundings in the future.

words.englishDefinition: Having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
words.japaneseExplanation: お金あるいは価値のある財産の潤沢な供給があるさま。
words.example: I was born into a wealthy family.

words.englishDefinition: to arrange things or plan an event
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を整理したり、行事を準備したりすること。
words.example: We need to organize the school festival together.

words.englishDefinition: Forsake, leave behind
words.japaneseExplanation: 見放す、置き去りにする。
words.example: We had to abandon the car.

words.englishDefinition: (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きている宿主の細胞内のみでそれ自身を複製する極微の感染性の病原菌。多くは病原性である。
words.example: I think I have a virus on my computer.

words.englishDefinition: Of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能な限りの程度、範囲、強度の。
words.example: I hear you've done some pretty extreme stuff.

words.englishDefinition: Observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
words.japaneseExplanation: 観察、確かめる、入念に調べるまたは検査する。
words.example: I want to examine you again tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: A document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 述べられている事実が真実であることを証明する文書。
words.example: I wonder where I can use this gift certificate.

words.englishDefinition: With rapid movements
words.japaneseExplanation: 急速な動きで。
words.example: I learn new ideas rapidly.

words.englishDefinition: Despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
words.japaneseExplanation: それと反対（通常、譲歩に続く）な何にもかかわらずでも。
words.example: I slept for ten hours, nevertheless I'm still tired.

words.englishDefinition: Prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に法的手段または社会的圧力によって禁止する。
words.example: I have good reason to ban him from using the computer.

words.englishDefinition: The relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion
words.japaneseExplanation: 評価に関する何かの相対振幅。
words.example: I don't know how to pay you this amount of money.

words.englishDefinition: an explanation or set of ideas about how something works
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事の仕組みを説明する考え方や理論。科学では証拠に支えられた体系的な説明。
words.example: We discussed a theory about how children learn languages.

words.englishDefinition: without being prevented by something
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
words.example: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

words.englishDefinition: Gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: （通例真実とうそを取り混ぜた）ゴシップが口コミで広まっていくこと。
words.example: I know better than to be believe such a rumor.

words.englishDefinition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
words.example: We should invent a secret language.

words.englishDefinition: Make impure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不潔にする。
words.example: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.

words.englishDefinition: Something that aids or promotes well-being
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸福を助け、推進する何か。
words.example: I want to give you the benefit of the doubt.

words.englishDefinition: Involving only main features
words.japaneseExplanation: 主要な特徴だけを伴うさま。
words.example: I think that overall we're in good shape.

words.englishDefinition: Hold back to a later time
words.japaneseExplanation: しばらく隠しておく。
words.example: We had to postpone the game because of rain.

words.englishDefinition: Obtain or arrange (for oneself) in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 前もって得る、または準備する（自分で）。
words.example: We would like to reserve a table for 6 o'clock.

words.englishDefinition: Elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に海水面または地表からの高さ。
words.example: I don't feel well at such a high altitude.

words.englishDefinition: no longer existing as a living species
words.japaneseExplanation: その種の生き物が一頭も残っていないこと。
words.example: The dodo became extinct hundreds of years ago.

words.englishDefinition: Uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般に無学の。知識あるいは高い教養が不足していること。
words.example: I just realized that I'm quite ignorant about the world.

words.englishDefinition: Make an effort or attempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力する、または試みる。
words.example: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?

words.englishDefinition: The outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
words.japaneseExplanation: 物体の外側の境界、または境界となるあるいはそれに似た物質の層。
words.example: I saw several fish swimming near the surface of the water.

words.englishDefinition: Estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較により査定される。絶対でないか完全でない。
words.example: I have a relative who lives around here.

words.englishDefinition: Important in effect or meaning
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響あるいは意味において重要な。
words.example: I desire to make a significant change in my life.

words.englishDefinition: to be made up of particular things
words.japaneseExplanation: consist of で、何から構成されているかを表す。
words.example: The course consists of ten weekly lessons.

words.japanese: をするもてなす、楽しませる
words.englishDefinition: Provide entertainment for
words.japaneseExplanation: エンターテイメントを提供する。
words.example: I need to entertain myself with something.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that can be consumed to produce energy
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを生み出すために消費される物質。
words.example: How much fuel do you need?

words.englishDefinition: Causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
words.japaneseExplanation: 心配を示す、それで一杯のまたはそれを引き起こす。
words.example: I get anxious waiting for a friend for a long time.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚によって感知されることができる。抽象的でないまたは非実在的でない。
words.example: What do you intend to do with the concrete?

words.englishDefinition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
words.example: I became unable to maintain my self-control.

words.englishDefinition: Build again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び構築する。
words.example: I have enough money to rebuild the house.

words.englishDefinition: wanting to know or learn about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を知りたいと思う、好奇心のある状態。
words.example: I'm curious about how this machine works.

words.englishDefinition: Without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
words.japaneseExplanation: 遅れ、または躊躇なしで。介入する時間なしで。
words.example: I wrote to him that he needs to come immediately.

words.englishDefinition: Reject with contempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽蔑して拒絶する。
words.example: I do not want to reject this claim.

words.englishDefinition: Your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 信じる、信じないの基礎となるもの。信じることの基礎を形成する知識。
words.example: We have all the evidence against you we need.

words.englishDefinition: Many times at short intervals
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
words.example: I frequently have a hard time sleeping at night.

words.englishDefinition: Without question and beyond doubt
words.japaneseExplanation: 確かにそして紛れもなく。
words.example: You should definitely ask him out.

words.englishDefinition: Behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の方法で振る舞う。特定の振舞いを示す。
words.example: I don't need you telling me how to behave.

words.englishDefinition: Break down, literally or metaphorically
words.japaneseExplanation: 文字通り、または、比喩的に壊れる。
words.example: I feel like I'm about to collapse.

words.englishDefinition: A process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物が異なる段階（特により発達した、または成熟した段階）に次第に移行する過程。
words.example: Do you believe in evolution?

words.englishDefinition: In large part; mainly or chiefly
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分において。主に、または大方。
words.example: I mostly do not want to think about anything anymore.

words.japanese: 観察する、 (法などを)守る
words.englishDefinition: Stick to correctly or closely
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しく、またはきっちりと貼りつく。
words.example: I like to observe people.

words.englishDefinition: Mark as different
words.japaneseExplanation: 異なっていると強調される。
words.example: We need to distinguish right from wrong.

words.englishDefinition: To stress, single out as important
words.japaneseExplanation: 強調するために、重要であるとして選び出す。
words.example: I was born to emphasize out my difference from most other people.

words.englishDefinition: To throw or bend back (from a surface)
words.japaneseExplanation: 背中（表面から）を放り投げるあるいは、曲げる。
words.example: I need a little time to reflect upon it.

words.englishDefinition: Stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何かに対して立ち上がりまたは抵抗する。
words.example: I don't know if I can resist anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Become fixed or fastened
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された、固定される。
words.example: Please fasten your seat belt.

words.englishDefinition: A division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant
words.japaneseExplanation: 茎が分裂したもの、または植物の主要な茎から生じる派生的な茎。
words.example: I don't think that that branch can support your weight.

words.englishDefinition: The dressed hairy coat of a mammal
words.japaneseExplanation: 哺乳動物の整えられた毛状の外被。
words.example: I want to buy a fur coat for my wife.

words.englishDefinition: Make a strategic, offensive, assault against an enemy, opponent, or a target
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵、相手、または目標に対して戦略的な、そして、不快な襲撃をする。
words.example: We have the right to strike.

words.englishDefinition: a situation where movement is blocked
words.japaneseExplanation: 車が混み合ったり、機械の物が詰まったりして動けない状態。
words.example: We were late because of a traffic jam.

words.englishDefinition: Acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠点、短所または失敗を認める。
words.example: I think he should apologize to the teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であるあるいは事実であると取る。確認または証明なしで受け入れる。
words.example: I have reason to assume that it's not true.

words.englishDefinition: an organization for research, education, or a special purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 研究や教育などの目的で設けられた機関。
words.example: She works at an institute that studies the environment.

words.englishDefinition: The part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
words.japaneseExplanation: 腐植土や分解した岩石から成る地表の一部。
words.example: It's difficult to grow anything in this soil.

words.englishDefinition: A reference point to shoot at
words.japaneseExplanation: 狙い撃つ標点。
words.example: You hit the center of the target.

words.englishDefinition: Win a victory over
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝利を収める。
words.example: I know I can defeat you.

words.englishDefinition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
words.example: What was the author thinking while he was writing this book?

words.englishDefinition: A native or naturalized member of a state or other political community
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国、または、別の政治共同体に属する生来の、または、帰化した構成員。
words.example: You want to become a citizen, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: Terminate, end, or take out
words.japaneseExplanation: 終わらせるか、途切れさせるか、取り除く。
words.example: You can't go back into the past to eliminate yourself.

words.englishDefinition: The state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠けているか入手できないものを必要とする状態。
words.example: Our problem is more than just a lack of money.

words.englishDefinition: A possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
words.japaneseExplanation: 状況の好ましい組み合わせによる可能性。
words.example: I decided to take the opportunity to go and visit him.

words.englishDefinition: The educator who has executive authority for a school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校を管理する権限を持つ教育者。
words.example: I got sent to the principal’s office today.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles
words.japaneseExplanation: 取っ手のない（通例筒状の）広口容器。
words.example: I tried to open the jar, but I couldn't.

words.englishDefinition: Praise somewhat dishonestly
words.japaneseExplanation: いくぶん不正に称賛する。
words.example: You don't need to flatter me, I already know my worth.

words.englishDefinition: Payment made in return for a service rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 提供されたサービスに対する支払い。
words.example: You told him that he should have a reward.

words.englishDefinition: A reserve of money set aside for some purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの目的のために取っておかれる資金。
words.example: I have a college fund.

words.japanese: 発射する、開始する、売り出す
words.englishDefinition: Propel with force
words.japaneseExplanation: 力で推進する。
words.example: Our school will launch a newspaper.

words.englishDefinition: Arrange in stacks
words.japaneseExplanation: 堆積で配置する。
words.example: How is it that dishes pile up so quickly?

words.englishDefinition: A distinct feature or element in a problem
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりとした特徴あるいは問題の要素。
words.example: We must consider every aspect of the problem.

words.englishDefinition: The means of connection between things linked in series
words.japaneseExplanation: 連続した物事同士の結びつき。
words.example: My friend sent me a link to this video.

words.englishDefinition: The time of a particular event
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な出来事のあるとき。
words.example: Please allow me to say a few words on this occasion.

words.englishDefinition: Feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
words.japaneseExplanation: 悔恨を感じる。遺憾に感じる。
words.example: I have a feeling I'm going to regret this later.

words.englishDefinition: Place under restrictions; limit access to
words.japaneseExplanation: 制限の下に置く。アクセスを制限する。
words.example: You have no right to restrict Tom.

words.englishDefinition: The extent downward or backward or inward
words.japaneseExplanation: 下方、後方、または、内部への範囲。
words.example: I have no doubt about the depth of his feelings.

words.englishDefinition: Any strong feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い気持ちの総称。
words.example: Her emotion was too strong for words.
